title.zh: 卷22 本紀二十二 穆宗本紀二
title.raw: 卷22 本紀二十二 穆宗本紀二

sentences.zh: 六年丁卯春正月己未，任、賴諸匪竄孝感、德安，官軍失利，總兵張樹珊死之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, dingmao, spring, first month, on day jiwei, Ren and Lai bandits fled to Xiaogan and De'an; government troops were defeated; Grand Commander Zhang Shushan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, spring 1, jiwei: Ren and Lai bandits reached Xiaogan and De'an; troops lost and Zhang Shushan was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復靖遠。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Jingyuan was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Jingyuan was retaken.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，革官文總督，召來京。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Guan Wen was removed as governor-general and summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Guan Wen lost his governor-general post and was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以李鴻章為湖廣總督，調李瀚章為江蘇巡撫，以劉昆為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was made Huguang governor-general; Li Hanzhang was transferred as Jiangsu governor; Liu Kun was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang took Huguang, Li Hanzhang Jiangsu, and Liu Kun Hunan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，張錫嶸剿捻匪於西安魚化鎮，死之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Zhang Xisheng attacked Nian bandits at Yuhua town in Xi'an and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhang Xisheng fell fighting Nian bandits at Xi'an's Yuhua town.

sentences.zh: 劉松山軍大捷。

translations.literal: Liu Songshan's army won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan won a major victory.

sentences.zh: 命喬松年專辦陝西軍務。

translations.literal: Qiao Songnian was ordered to supervise Shaanxi military affairs exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Songnian was put in sole charge of Shaanxi operations.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命左宗棠為欽差大臣，督辦陝、甘軍務，賞劉典三品卿銜，幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zuo Zongtang was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Shaanxi-Gansu military affairs; Liu Dian was rewarded with Third Rank Courtier rank to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Zuo Zongtang became commissioner for Shaanxi-Gansu and Liu Dian received third-rank rank to assist.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，哈密回匪竄巴里坤，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Hami Hui rebels raided Barkol; government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Hami Hui raiders hit Barkol and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 訥爾濟病免，以伊勒屯為巴里坤領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Nierji was dismissed on illness; Yiletun was made Barkol detachment commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Nierji was relieved and Yiletun became Barkol detachment commander.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命徐繼畬仍在總理各國事務衙門行走，管新設同文館事務。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Xu Jishe was ordered to continue serving at the Zongli Yamen and manage affairs of the newly established Tongwenguan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Xu Jishe stayed at the Zongli Yamen to run the new Tongwenguan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，官軍復鎮雄。

translations.literal: On day jimao, government troops recovered Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day troops retook Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉朔，劉銘傳追剿任、賴於鍾祥，失利。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day yiyou: Liu Mingchuan pursued and attacked Ren and Lai at Zhongxiang and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, yiyou, Liu Mingchuan lost a pursuit fight with Ren and Lai at Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 鮑超進擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Bao Chao advanced to attack and routed them completely.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao counterattacked and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命李鴻章督軍赴豫。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Li Hongzhang was ordered to lead troops to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Li Hongzhang was sent to command in Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，京師疫。

translations.literal: On day renchen, pestilence broke out in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day plague struck Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，擢劉松山為廣東陸路提督。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Liu Songshan was promoted to Guangdong provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Liu Songshan became Guangdong land commander.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，陝回馬生彥等降。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Shaanxi Hui Ma Shengyan and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Shaanxi Hui led by Ma Shengyan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 減廣州屬徵收米折銀十九萬有奇，著為令。

translations.literal: Collection of rice commutation silver under Guangzhou's jurisdiction was reduced by over 190,000 taels and fixed as statute.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou rice-commutation silver was cut by 190,000-odd taels and made permanent law.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，桂軍復泗城。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Guangxi troops recovered Sicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Guangxi troops retook Sicheng.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以丁寶楨為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Ding Baozhen was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Ding Baozhen became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，洮州復陷。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Taozhou fell again.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Taozhou was lost again.

sentences.zh: 壬子，雲貴總督勞崇光卒，以張凱嵩代之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Lao Chongguang died; Zhang Kaisong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Lao Chongguang died and Zhang Kaisong took Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，鄂軍剿賊於蘄水，失利，道員彭毓橘等死之。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingsi: Hubei troops attacked bandits at Qishui and were defeated; Circuit Intendant Peng Yuju and others died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, dingsi, Hubei troops lost at Qishui and Peng Yuju was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，總兵段步雲軍潰於鄜州。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Grand Commander Duan Buyun's army was routed at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Duan Buyun's force collapsed at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鮑超累乞病，諭仍赴黃州。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Bao Chao repeatedly begged sick leave; he was instructed to proceed nonetheless to Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Bao Chao's repeated sick leaves were denied and he was told to go to Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命倭仁在總理各國事務衙門行走，辭，不允。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Woren was ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen; he declined and was not permitted to do so.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Woren was ordered to the Zongli Yamen, refused, and was overruled.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，諭李雲麟等安頓新疆難民。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Li Yunlin and others were instructed to settle Xinjiang refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Li Yunlin was told to resettle Xinjiang refugees.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，曹克忠軍復洮州。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Cao Kezhong's army recovered Taozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Cao Kezhong retook Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，回匪馬占鰲等犯西寧。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Hui bandits Ma Zhan'ao and others attacked Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Ma Zhan'ao's Hui raiders struck Xining.

sentences.zh: 是春，免浙江仁和等場被擾逋課、山西平定等處民欠倉穀。

translations.literal: That spring, overdue levies were remitted for Zhejiang Renhe and other salt yards disturbed by raids and for civilian grain debts to government granaries in Shanxi Pingding and other places.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Zhejiang salt-yard arrears and Shanxi granary debts were forgiven after disturbance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，允琉球國子弟入監讀書。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dinghai: the request that Ryukyu princes and sons study in the Imperial Academy was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, dinghai, Ryukyu students were allowed into the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 予鮑超病假。

translations.literal: Bao Chao was granted sick leave.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao got sick leave.

sentences.zh: 戊子，何琯軍復哈密。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, He Guan's army recovered Hami.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day He Guan retook Hami.

sentences.zh: 己丑，周祖培卒。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Zhou Zupei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhou Zupei died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，吉林馬賊平。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Jilin horse bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Jilin horse bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙申，日斯巴尼亞使來換約。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Spanish envoy came to exchange treaties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Spain's envoy arrived to renew treaties.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，劉松山大破捻、回於同州。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Liu Songshan heavily defeated Nian and Hui forces at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Liu Songshan routed Nian and Hui at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，贈哈密殉難紥薩克郡王伯錫爾親王，建祠。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Zasak prince of Hami who died resisting invasion, Boshier, was posthumously ennobled as prince and given a temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Boshier of Hami was made a posthumous prince and memorialized.

sentences.zh: 德勒克多爾濟病免，命麟興為烏里雅蘇台將軍，調榮全為參贊。

translations.literal: Delekeduoerji was dismissed on illness; Lin Xing was made Uriankhai general and Rongquan was transferred as co-administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Ill Delekeduoerji was relieved; Lin Xing became Uriankhai general and Rongquan his deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁未，瞻對番目大蓋折布伏誅。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Zhandui tribal chief Dage Zhebu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhandui chief Dage Zhebu was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，貴德回匪叛，陷廳城。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Guide Hui rebels mutinied and took the circuit seat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Guide Hui rebels seized the seat.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，哈密回匪竄玉門，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: Hami Hui rebels raided Yumen; government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jiayin, Hami Hui raiders hit Yumen and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 以旱，命恤難民、育嬰孩、揜暴露、贍陣亡者家屬。

translations.literal: Because of drought, orders were issued to succor refugees, rear infants, bury the exposed dead, and support families of troops killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Drought orders told officials to aid refugees, care for infants, bury the dead, and support soldiers' families.

sentences.zh: 戊午，諭廣購書籍，並重刊御纂欽定經史，頒發各學。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, purchase of books was broadly ordered and imperially compiled and approved classics and histories were reprinted and distributed to all schools.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court ordered book purchases and reprints of imperial classics for all schools.

sentences.zh: 己未，郭寶昌、劉松山兩軍破張總愚於朝邑。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the armies of Guo Baochang and Liu Songshan defeated Zhang Zongyu at Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Guo Baochang and Liu Songshan beat Zhang Zongyu at Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 免郭寶昌遣戍。

translations.literal: Guo Baochang was exempted from banishment to military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Baochang's exile sentence was lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命曾國藩為大學士，駱秉章協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zeng Guofan was made Grand Secretary and Luo Bingzhang assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Zeng Guofan became Grand Secretary with Luo Bingzhang as assistant.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔清理庶獄。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, an edict ordered clearing up miscellaneous prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict ordered jail cleanup.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，桂軍復荔波、義寧。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Guangxi troops recovered Libo and Yining.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Guangxi troops retook Libo and Yining.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔求直言，覈減宮廷用款。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an edict sought frank remonstrance and verified reduction of palace expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the throne sought candor and cut palace spending.

sentences.zh: 己巳，捻匪渡運河，予丁寶楨嚴議。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Nian bandits crossed the Grand Canal; Ding Baozhen was subjected to severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Nian bandits crossed the canal and Ding Baozhen faced severe censure.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賊竄長垣，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, bandits fled to Changyuan; government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day raiders reached Changyuan and were driven off.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以剿賊無功，褫曾國荃頂戴，與李鶴年下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, for failure to suppress bandits, Zeng Guoquan's peacock feather was removed and he and Li Henian were referred for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Zeng Guoquan lost his feather and he and Li Henian faced severe censure for failure.

sentences.zh: 諭李鴻章戴罪圖功。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was instructed to achieve merit while bearing guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was told to redeem himself by winning.

sentences.zh: 京師地震。

translations.literal: The capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing shook.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，董福祥陷陝西甘泉。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Dong Fuxiang seized Ganquan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Dong Fuxiang took Shaanxi's Ganquan.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，總理各國事務衙門言俄人窺伺新疆，下大學士、尚書、左都御史會總理王大臣妥議。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: the Zongli Yamen reported Russians were watching Xinjiang covetously; the matter was referred to Grand Secretaries, ministers, the left censor-in-chief, and the prince-ministers of the Zongli Yamen for proper deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiashen, the Zongli Yamen warned of Russian designs on Xinjiang and referred the matter upstairs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，申禁州縣浮收漕糧。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, over-collection of grain transport tax by prefectures and counties was sternly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day counties were forbidden from excess grain-tax levies.

sentences.zh: 甲午，倭仁乞病，罷職務，仍以大學士直弘德殿。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Woren begged sick leave; his duties were removed but he remained Grand Secretary attending at Hongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Woren took sick leave, lost his posts, but kept his grand secretary seat at Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙未，官軍敗捻匪於即墨。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, government troops defeated Nian bandits at Jimo.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day troops beat Nian bandits at Jimo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，順直久旱，飢，賑恤之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Shuntian and Zhili had long drought and famine; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day drought and famine in Shuntian-Zhili brought relief orders.

sentences.zh: 允鮑超回籍。

translations.literal: Bao Chao's request to return home was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao was allowed to go home.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李鴻章檄劉銘傳、潘鼎新等軍防運河，扼膠、萊。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Li Hongzhang ordered Liu Mingchuan, Pan Dingxin, and other armies to defend the Grand Canal and block Jiao and Lai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Li Hongzhang sent Liu Mingchuan and Pan Dingxin to hold the canal against Jiao and Lai.

sentences.zh: 命成祿節制黃祖淦、王仁和兩軍。

translations.literal: Cheng Lu was ordered to command the armies of Huang Zugan and Wang Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lu was put over Huang Zugan and Wang Renhe.

sentences.zh: 以畿內亢旱，撥閩、廣、贛釐捐三十萬，浙、閩海關洋稅三十五萬備賑需。

translations.literal: Because of severe drought in the metropolitan region, 300,000 taels from Fujian-Guangdong-Jiangxi transit levies and 350,000 from Zhejiang-Fujian customs foreign taxes were allocated for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan drought drew 300,000 taels from transit levies and 350,000 from customs for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，甘回陷陝西華亭，旋復之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Gansu Hui forces took Huating in Shaanxi but soon it was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Gansu Hui took Shaanxi's Huating but troops soon retook it.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免昌平例貢果品。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the annual tribute of fruit from Changping was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Changping's fruit tribute was waived.

sentences.zh: 己酉，自三月不雨以來，上頻祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, since rain had failed from the third month onward, the Emperor repeatedly prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Emperor kept praying for rain after drought since month 3.

sentences.zh: 至是日雨。

translations.literal: By this day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain finally came that day.

sentences.zh: 是月，免陝西乾州等屬災擾額賦。

translations.literal: That month, assessed taxes were remitted for Qianzhou and other districts in Shaanxi disturbed by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shaanxi disaster districts had taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，雨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiwei: rain.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, jiwei, it rained.

sentences.zh: 陝軍復甘泉。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops recovered Ganquan.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops retook Ganquan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Yongding River breached its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以捻匪過膠萊河，諭各路扼守河、運兩防，奪丁寶楨職，仍留任。

translations.literal: On day jimao, because Nian bandits had crossed the Jiaolai River, all routes were instructed to hold the Yellow River and canal defenses; Ding Baozhen's post was removed but he remained in office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Nian crossed the Jiaolai and routes were told to hold river defenses; Ding Baozhen lost rank but stayed on.

sentences.zh: 是月，免湖南晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes were remitted for Hunan Huangzhou disturbed by raids.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huangzhou's disturbed tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，停奉天冬圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: the winter hunt in Fengtian was halted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingxu, Fengtian's winter hunt was canceled.

sentences.zh: 戊子，湖北匪首劉漢忠伏誅。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Hubei rebel chief Liu Hanzhong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Hubei chief Liu Hanzhong was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命黎培敬會辦貴州剿撫及屯田事宜。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Li Peijing was ordered to assist in Guizhou suppression-pacification and military colony affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Li Peijing was sent to assist Guizhou pacification and colonies.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，奉軍剿平孤山、法庫等處賊匪。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Fengtian troops pacified bandits at Gushan, Faku, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Fengtian troops pacified Gushan and Faku bandits.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，署貴州提督趙德光剿賊於安平，死之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Acting Guizhou Military Commander Zhao Deguang attacked bandits at Anping and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day acting commander Zhao Deguang died fighting at Anping.

sentences.zh: 丙申，穆隆阿等軍剿梟匪於文安，失利。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Mulonga and others' army attacked outlaw bands at Wen'an and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Mulonga lost a fight with outlaw bands at Wen'an.

sentences.zh: 濟陽土匪作亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Jiyang; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyang bandits rebelled and were crushed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，迤西回犯姚州。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Western Yunnan Hui attacked Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day western Yunnan Hui struck Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貴州巡撫張亮基開缺嚴議，命曾璧光署之，布政使嚴樹森以逗遛褫職。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Guizhou Governor Zhang Liangji was opened from office for severe deliberation; Zeng Biguang was ordered to act; Provincial Administration Commissioner Yan Shusen was stripped of office for dawdling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhang Liangji faced severe censure, Zeng Biguang acted as governor, and Yan Shusen lost his post for delay.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，召陳國瑞來京。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Chen Guorui was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Chen Guorui was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以淮、楚各軍所至騷擾，諭李鴻章嚴申軍律。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because Huai and Chu armies everywhere committed disturbances, Li Hongzhang was instructed to enforce military discipline strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Li Hongzhang was told to tighten discipline after Huai-Chu troops harassed civilians.

sentences.zh: 己酉，裁熱河木稅。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Rehe timber tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Rehe's timber tax was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，創建福建船塢。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Fujian shipyard was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Fujian's naval dockyard was founded.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，允左宗棠調曹克忠赴陝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: Zuo Zongtang's request to transfer Cao Kezhong to Shaanxi was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renzi, Zuo Zongtang's transfer of Cao Kezhong to Shaanxi was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賴、任諸匪犯運河，牛師韓軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Lai and Ren bandits attacked the Grand Canal; Niu Shihan's army drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Lai and Ren hit the canal and Niu Shihan drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，河、狄、西寧回眾投誠。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Hui communities of He, Di, and Xining submitted in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day He, Di, and Xining Hui groups surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，停山東例貢。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Shandong's annual tribute presentation was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Shandong's tribute presentations were halted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，安置額魯特游牧於額爾齊斯河。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Oirat nomads were resettled on the Irtysh River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Oirat nomads were settled on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 甲子，總理各國事務衙門言預籌修約事。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Zongli Yamen reported on pre-arranging treaty revision affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Zongli Yamen reported on preparing treaty revisions.

sentences.zh: 諭曾國藩等各抒所見以聞。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan and others were instructed to state their views separately for report.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan and others were told to submit their views.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命丁日昌赴上海辦理義國換約。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Ding Richang was ordered to go to Shanghai to handle Italy's treaty exchange.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Ding Richang was sent to Shanghai for Italy's treaty renewal.

sentences.zh: 壬申，撫恤巫山被水災民。

translations.literal: On day renshen, victims of flood disaster at Wushan were succored.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Wushan flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命榮全與棍噶札拉參籌辦哈薩克剿撫機宜。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Rongquan and Kungazhala were ordered to deliberate measures for Kazakh suppression and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Rongquan and Kungazhala were told to plan Kazakh pacification.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命馮子材赴左江，專辦南、太軍務。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Feng Zicai was ordered to proceed to Zuojiang to supervise exclusively Nan and Tai military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Feng Zicai was sent to Zuojiang for Nan and Tai operations.

sentences.zh: 賑襄陽等府災民。

translations.literal: Disaster victims in Xiangyang and other prefectures were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang and other prefectures received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，諭各路統兵大臣及各督撫嚴申軍律。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiwei: an edict told commanders-in-chief on each route and every governor-general and governor to enforce military discipline strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On month 10 guiwei, route commanders and all governors were ordered to tighten military discipline.

sentences.zh: 甲申，察哈爾都統色爾固善卒，以庫倫辦事大臣文盛代之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Chahar commander-in-chief Se'ergushan died; Urga commissioner Wensheng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Chahar commander Se'ergushan died and Urga commissioner Wensheng replaced him.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以張廷岳為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zhang Tingyue was made Urga commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhang Tingyue became Urga commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，陝軍復寧條梁及宜君。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Shaanxi forces recovered Ningtiaoliang and Yijun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Shaanxi troops retook Ningtiaoliang and Yijun.

sentences.zh: 飭席寶田軍赴沅州，統援黔軍務。

translations.literal: Xi Baotian's army was ordered to Yuanzhou to command Guizhou relief forces.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Baotian was sent to Yuanzhou to command Guizhou relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，迤西回陷定遠、大姚。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Western Yunnan Muslims took Dingyuan and Dayao.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yunnan Muslims took Dingyuan and Dayao.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，汪元方卒。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Wang Yuanfang died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wang Yuanfang died.

sentences.zh: 命沈桂芬在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Shen Guifen was ordered to study and serve on the Grand Council under councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Guifen was assigned to study under Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曾國荃病免，以郭柏蔭為湖北巡撫，蘇鳳文為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Zeng Guoquan was removed for illness; Guo Boyin became Hubei governor and Su Fengwen Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, ill Zeng Guoquan was replaced; Guo Boyin took Hubei and Su Fengwen Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 賑山東被水災民。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Shandong were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，派美前使蒲安臣往有約各國辦理中外交涉。

translations.literal: On day yisi, former American envoy Anson Burlingame was dispatched to treaty powers to handle Sino-foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Burlingame was sent to treaty powers on foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，回匪陷寶雞、正寧，旋復之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Muslim rebels took Baoji and Zhengning, soon retaken.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Muslims took Baoji and Zhengning but they were soon recovered.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌朔，命道員志剛、郎中孫家穀往有約各國充辦理交涉事務大臣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu, first day: Staff Director Zhi Gang and Director Sun Jiagu were sent to treaty powers as commissioners for foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, gengxu: Zhi Gang and Sun Jiagu became foreign-affairs commissioners to treaty powers.

sentences.zh: 壬子，劉銘傳等軍剿賊贛榆，大捷，任柱伏誅。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Liu Mingchuan's army routed rebels at Ganyu in a great victory; Ren Zhu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Liu Mingchuan won at Ganyu and executed Ren Zhu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以梟匪蔓延，褫劉長佑職，仍責自效。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because bandit chiefs were spreading, Liu Changyou was stripped of office but still held to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Liu Changyou was dismissed yet kept to redeem himself as bandits spread.

sentences.zh: 命官文署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Guanwen was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Guanwen was assigned acting Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陝軍剿捻洛川，遇回匪，失利，提督李祥和死之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Shaanxi forces fought Nian bandits at Luochuan, met Muslim rebels, were defeated, and Regional Commander Li Xianghe died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Shaanxi troops lost at Luochuan to Muslims and Nian; Li Xianghe was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張總愚陷延川、綏德。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Zhang Zongyu took Yan'an and Suide.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhang Zongyu took Yan'an and Suide.

sentences.zh: 甲子，增設布倫托海辦事大臣，以李雲麟為之，明瑤為幫辦，福濟為科布多幫辦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, a Burultokhai commissioner was added; Li Yunlin was appointed, Mingyao as assistant, and Fu Ji as Kobdo assistant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Burultokhai got a commissioner: Li Yunlin, with Mingyao and Fu Ji assisting.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，劉銘傳軍剿賊於諸城，大捷。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Liu Mingchuan's army routed rebels at Zhucheng in a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liu Mingchuan won a great victory at Zhucheng.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，陝軍復延川、綏德。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Shaanxi forces recovered Yan'an and Suide.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Shaanxi troops retook Yan'an and Suide.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，張總愚竄吉州，左宗棠、趙長齡均褫職留任。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: Zhang Zongyu fled into Jizhou; Zuo Zongtang and Zhao Changling were both stripped yet kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12 renwu: Zhang Zongyu fled to Jizhou; Zuo and Zhao were dismissed but kept.

sentences.zh: 成祿剿回匪於肅州，失利，總兵黃祖淦死之。

translations.literal: Cheng Lu fought Muslim rebels at Suzhou, was defeated, and Brigadier Huang Zujin died.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lu lost at Suzhou to Muslims and Huang Zujin was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賞陳國瑞頭等侍衛，隸左宗棠軍。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Chen Guorui was granted First Class Imperial Bodyguard and attached to Zuo Zongtang's army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Chen Guorui became a first-class bodyguard under Zuo Zongtang.

sentences.zh: 劉銘傳等剿賊於壽光，大捷。

translations.literal: Liu Mingchuan and others routed rebels at Shouguang in a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan won a great victory at Shouguang.

sentences.zh: 迤西回陷祿豐、廣通、元謀。

translations.literal: Western Yunnan Muslims took Lufeng, Guangtong, and Yuanmou.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Muslims took Lufeng, Guangtong, and Yuanmou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，官軍復吉州。

translations.literal: On day jichou, government troops recovered Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the army retook Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，直隸梟匪平。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zhili bandit chiefs were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhili bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賞劉長佑三品頂戴，命率所部回籍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Liu Changyou was granted third-rank insignia and ordered to lead his troops home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Liu Changyou gained third rank and was sent home with his troops.

sentences.zh: 永定河堤工合龍。

translations.literal: The Yongding River dike works were joined.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River dike was closed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命蔣益澧以按察使候補，隸左宗棠軍，率楚勇回籍。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Jiang Yizao was ordered to serve as acting surveillance commissioner under Zuo Zongtang and lead Hunan braves home.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Jiang Yizao joined Zuo's command as acting intendant and led Hunan troops home.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，駱秉章卒。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Luo Bingzhang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Luo Bingzhang died.

sentences.zh: 劉松山等敗張總愚於洪洞。

translations.literal: Liu Songshan and others defeated Zhang Zongyu at Hongdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan beat Zhang Zongyu at Hongdong.

sentences.zh: 調吳棠為四川總督，以馬新貽為閩浙總督，李瀚章調浙江巡撫，丁日昌為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Wu Tang was transferred to Sichuan governor-general; Ma Xinyi became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Li Hanzhang was moved to Zhejiang governor and Ding Richang Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tang went to Sichuan, Ma Xinyi to Fujian-Zhejiang, Li Hanzhang to Zhejiang, and Ding Richang to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，淮軍剿賊高郵大捷，獲賴文光等，誅之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Huai army routed rebels at Gaoyou in a great victory, captured Lai Wenguang and others, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Huai army won at Gaoyou, captured Lai Wenguang, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，東捻平，加賚李鴻章、曾國藩世職，賞劉銘傳、英翰及郭松林、楊鼎勛、善慶世職有差，復曾國荃頂戴。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the eastern Nian were pacified; Li Hongzhang and Zeng Guofan were granted hereditary offices; Liu Mingchuan, Ying Han, Guo Songlin, Yang Dingxun, and Shan Qing received graded hereditary rewards; Zeng Guoquan's insignia was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the eastern Nian were pacified; Li and Zeng gained hereditary rank and Liu, Ying, and others graded rewards; Zeng Guoquan's insignia returned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以左宗棠督師入晉，命庫克吉泰、喬松年、劉典督辦陝西軍務。

translations.literal: On day renyin, because Zuo Zongtang led the army into Shanxi, Kukejitai, Qiao Songnian, and Liu Dian were ordered to supervise Shaanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, as Zuo entered Shanxi, Kukejitai, Qiao Songnian, and Liu Dian took Shaanxi command.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命楊占鰲署甘肅提督，接辦西路軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Yang Zhan'ao was ordered to act as Gansu regional commander and take over western-route military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yang Zhan'ao became acting Gansu commander for the western front.

sentences.zh: 戊申，左宗棠檄喜昌、劉松山等赴磁州迎剿。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Zuo Zongtang ordered Xi Chang and Liu Songshan and others to Cizhou for interception.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zuo sent Xi Chang and Liu Songshan to Cizhou to intercept.

sentences.zh: 諭張曜、劉銘傳等會剿。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao, Liu Mingchuan, and others were edicted to join in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao, Liu Mingchuan, and others were ordered to suppress jointly.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命鄭敦謹往山西查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Zheng Dunjin was sent to Shanxi to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zheng Dunjin was sent to investigate in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，免浙江仁和等場未墾灶課、雲南嵩明等屬歉收額糧。

translations.literal: This month, unopened salt-field levies in Zhejiang Renhe and elsewhere and deficient grain quotas in Yunnan Songming and other districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This month, Zhejiang salt levies and Yunnan grain quotas were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: This year, Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute this year.

sentences.zh: 七年戊辰春正月庚戌朔，捻首李允等率眾降於盱眙，詔誅之，遣散餘眾。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day gengxu, first day: Nian chief Li Yun and others led their followers to surrender at Xuyi; an edict ordered them executed and the rest dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, month 1 gengxu: Li Yun and other Nian chiefs surrendered at Xuyi, were executed, and their men dispersed.

sentences.zh: 命朱鳳標協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Zhu Fengbiao was ordered to assist the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fengbiao was assigned to assist grand secretaries.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，回匪復陷正寧。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Muslim rebels again took Zhengning.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Muslims retook Zhengning.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，喜昌等擊張總愚於河內，大捷。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Xi Chang and others routed Zhang Zongyu inside the Yellow River in a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xi Chang routed Zhang Zongyu on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 西寧回陷北川。

translations.literal: Xining Muslims took Beichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xining Muslims took Beichuan.

sentences.zh: 李雲麟乞病。

translations.literal: Li Yunlin pleaded illness.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yunlin asked leave for illness.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 以錫綸為布倫托海幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: Xilun was made assistant Burultokhai commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xilun became assistant Burultokhai commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，張總愚北竄定州，保定戒嚴，官文、左宗棠均褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhang Zongyu fled north to Dingzhou; Baoding was placed on alert; Guanwen and Zuo Zongtang were both stripped yet kept in office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Zongyu fled to Dingzhou, Baoding was alerted, and Guanwen and Zuo were dismissed but kept.

sentences.zh: 諭玉亮統神機營兵剿賊。

translations.literal: Yuliang was edicted to command Shenji Camp troops against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yuliang was ordered to lead Shenji Camp troops against rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，張總愚犯清苑，劉松山、郭寶昌等軍繞賊前剿之，予優敘。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Zhang Zongyu attacked Qingyuan; Liu Songshan, Guo Baochang, and other armies cut ahead of the rebels and were given preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhang Zongyu hit Qingyuan; Liu Songshan and Guo Baochang cut ahead and were commended.

sentences.zh: 陳國瑞、宋慶、張曜均以軍至保定。

translations.literal: Chen Guorui, Song Qing, and Zhang Yao all reached Baoding with their armies.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guorui, Song Qing, and Zhang Yao reached Baoding.

sentences.zh: 達賴請宥里塘犯東登工布死罪，允之。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama asked pardon for the death sentence of Dongdeng Gongbu, who had offended at Litang; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama's plea for Dongdeng Gongbu at Litang was granted.

sentences.zh: 命賈楨等設團防總局。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen and others were ordered to establish a general bureau for militia defense.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen and others were told to set up a militia defense bureau.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭令天津洋槍、練軍各隊赴河間，與山東軍聯絡防剿。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Tianjin foreign-rifle and training battalions were ordered to Hejian to link defenses with Shandong forces.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Tianjin rifle and training units were sent to Hejian to join Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李鴻章遣周盛波等軍北援。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Li Hongzhang sent Zhou Shengbo and other armies north in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Hongzhang sent Zhou Shengbo north to relieve.

sentences.zh: 趣左宗棠赴保定北方督剿。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang was urged to Baoding to supervise northern suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang was urged to Baoding to command the north.

sentences.zh: 命恭親王會同神機營王大臣辦巡防。

translations.literal: Prince Gong was ordered with Shenji Camp princes to manage patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong and Shenji princes were assigned patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 壬申，允英翰入衛畿疆，命統牛師韓軍駐黃河以南。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Ying Han was allowed to enter the capital region in defense; he was ordered to command Niu Shihan's army south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Ying Han entered the capital region and held Niu Shihan's army south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 飭程文炳軍赴河間會剿。

translations.literal: Cheng Wenbing's army was ordered to Hejian for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Wenbing was sent to Hejian for joint operations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，張總愚陷饒陽，旋復之。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Zongyu took Raoyang, soon retaken.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhang Zongyu took Raoyang but it was soon recovered.

sentences.zh: 賈楨以病致仕。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen retired for illness.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen retired ill.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命左宗棠總統各路官軍。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Zuo Zongtang was ordered to command all government armies on every route.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zuo Zongtang was made supreme commander of all routes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，官軍復渭源。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi: government troops recovered Weiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2 xinsi: the army retook Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命恭親王節制各路統兵大臣。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Prince Gong was ordered to control commanders-in-chief on every route.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Prince Gong was given authority over all route commanders.

sentences.zh: 戊子，回匪復陷寧條梁。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Muslim rebels again took Ningtiaoliang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Muslims retook Ningtiaoliang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，回匪竄伊克沙巴爾，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Muslim rebels fled to Yikeshaba'er; government troops beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Muslims fled to Yikeshaba'er and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 褫趙長齡、陳湜職，遣戍。

translations.literal: Zhao Changling and Chen Shi were stripped of office and banished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Changling and Chen Shi were dismissed and exiled.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，陝軍復寶雞。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Shaanxi forces recovered Baoji.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Shaanxi troops retook Baoji.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，滇軍解鎮雄圍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yunnan forces lifted the siege of Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yunnan troops relieved Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 迤西回陷楚雄。

translations.literal: Western Yunnan Muslims took Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Muslims took Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 乙未，豫、皖各軍敗張總愚於束鹿。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Henan and Anhui armies defeated Zhang Zongyu at Shulu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Henan and Anhui troops beat Zhang Zongyu at Shulu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，左宗棠、李鴻章等軍剿賊，迭破之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zuo Zongtang, Li Hongzhang, and other armies fought the rebels and repeatedly broke them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang repeatedly defeated the rebels.

sentences.zh: 回匪陷懷遠、神木。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels took Huaiyuan and Shenmu.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims took Huaiyuan and Shenmu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，白泥苗匪降。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Baimiao Miao rebels surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Baimiao Miao rebels surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以朝鮮請嚴邊禁，命延煦、奕榕赴奉天，會都興阿勘展邊事宜。

translations.literal: On day yisi, because Korea asked for strict border prohibitions, Yanshu and Yirong were sent to Fengtian with Duxing'a to survey border extension.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Korea's border plea sent Yanshu and Yirong to Fengtian with Duxing'a.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，張凱嵩乞病，諭責其逗留規避，褫職。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: Zhang Kaison pleaded illness; an edict rebuked his delay and evasion and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3 renzi: ill Zhang Kaison was rebuked for delay and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 回匪陷鄜州，劉典駐三原督剿。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels took Fuzhou; Liu Dian stationed at Sanyuan to supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims took Fuzhou; Liu Dian held Sanyuan to command suppression.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以劉岳昭為雲貴總督，岑毓英為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Liu Yuezhao was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Cen Yuying Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Liu Yuezhao became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Cen Yuying Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，陝軍復鄜州。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Shaanxi forces recovered Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Shaanxi troops retook Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭庶吉士散館仍試詩賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Hanlin bachelors leaving the Academy were again to be examined in regulated verse and fu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Hanlin graduates were again tested in verse and fu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張總愚竄延津、封丘，劉松山、郭寶昌擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zhang Zongyu fled to Yanjin and Fengqiu; Liu Songshan and Guo Baochang defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Zhang Zongyu fled to Yanjin and Fengqiu and was beaten by Liu Songshan and Guo Baochang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命沈桂芬為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Shen Guifen was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Shen Guifen became a Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命朱鳳標為大學士。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Zhu Fengbiao was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhu Fengbiao became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙子，迤西回陷易門。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Western Yunnan Muslims took Yimen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yunnan Muslims took Yimen.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張總愚竄滑縣，擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Zhang Zongyu fled to Huaxian and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhang Zongyu fled to Huaxian and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是月，免直隸安州等處澇地逋賦。

translations.literal: This month, overdue levies on flooded land in Zhili Anzhou and other places were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This month, Zhili flood levies at Anzhou and elsewhere were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯朔，哈密回陷五堡，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, day jimao, first day: Hami Muslims took Wubao; government troops beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4 jimao: Hami Muslims took Wubao but were driven back.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張總愚陷南皮。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zhang Zongyu took Nanpi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhang Zongyu took Nanpi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，諭左宗棠、李鴻章、丁寶楨等，督各軍於運河東西分路防剿。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Zuo Zongtang, Li Hongzhang, Ding Baozhen, and others were edicted to direct all armies in separate east and west routes along the Grand Canal for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zuo, Li, and Ding were told to guard and suppress on both sides of the canal.

sentences.zh: 己丑，苗匪何正觀降。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Miao rebel He Zhengguan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Miao chief He Zhengguan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陝軍剿回匪於邠州，失利，譚玉龍死之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Shaanxi forces fought Muslim rebels at Binzhou, were defeated, and Tan Yulong died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Shaanxi troops lost at Binzhou to Muslims and Tan Yulong was killed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Yongding River broke.

sentences.zh: 乙未，召都興阿來京。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Duxing'a was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Duxing'a was called to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，黎平苗犯晃、沅各境，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Liping Miao attacked Huang and Yuan borders; government troops beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Liping Miao raided Huang and Yuan and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，寧條梁回擾鄂爾多斯游牧，貝子札那格爾濟擊退之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Ningtiaoliang Muslims harassed Ordos nomads; Prince Zhanage'erji drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Ningtiaoliang Muslims raided Ordos and Prince Zhanage'erji repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 回匪犯哈密，伊勒屯等會擊退之。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels attacked Hami; Yiletun and others jointly repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels hit Hami; Yiletun and others drove them back.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜洪鈞等二百七十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Hong Jun and two hundred seventy others were granted jinshi degrees and appointment with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Hong Jun and 270 others received jinshi degrees with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 是月，免四川各土司三年租賦。

translations.literal: That month, three years' rent and tax were remitted for all native chieftains in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Sichuan tusi were exempted three years' rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 閏四月戊申朔，迤西回竄陷昆陽、新興、晉寧、呈貢、嵩明。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, new moon on day wushen: rebels from western Yunnan seized Kunyang, Xinxing, Jinning, Chenggong, and Songming.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month 4, wushen new moon, western Yunnan rebels took Kunyang, Xinxing, Jinning, Chenggong, and Songming.

sentences.zh: 戊午，回匪復陷神木。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Muslim rebels again seized Shenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Muslim rebels again took Shenmu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，陝軍復延長。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Shaanxi forces recovered Yanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Shaanxi forces recovered Yanchang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，董福祥投誠，諭立功自贖。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Dong Fuxiang submitted; he was ordered to redeem himself by merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Dong Fuxiang submitted and was told to earn pardon by merit.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，回匪踞烏紳旗，分擾準噶爾旗，偪托克托城。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Muslim rebels held Wushen Banner, raided the Dzungar banners in separate columns, and pressed Tuoketuo.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Muslim rebels held Wushen Banner, raided Dzungar banners, and pressed Tuoketuo.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，程文炳、陳國瑞、劉松山等軍擊張總愚於高唐、茌平、博平，大捷。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the armies of Cheng Wenbing, Chen Guorui, and Liu Songshan attacked Zhang Zongyu at Gaotang, Chiping, and Boxing and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Cheng Wenbing, Chen Guorui, and Liu Songshan routed Zhang Zongyu at Gaotang, Chiping, and Boxing.

sentences.zh: 賊竄東光。

translations.literal: The bandits fled into Dongguang.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits fled into Dongguang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，回匪再陷慶陽及寧州、合水，知縣楊炳華死之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Muslim rebels again seized Qingyang as well as Ningzhou and Heshui; Magistrate Yang Binghua died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Muslim rebels retook Qingyang, Ningzhou, and Heshui; Magistrate Yang Binghua was killed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命都興阿為欽差大臣，會同左宗棠、李鴻章剿捻、調遣春喜、陳國瑞、張曜、宋慶四軍，崇厚幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Du Xing'a was appointed Imperial Commissioner to join Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang in suppressing the Nian; Chunxi, Chen Guorui, Zhang Yao, and Song Qing's four armies were assigned, and Chonghou was ordered to assist military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Du Xing'a was made commissioner to join Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang against the Nian; four armies were assigned and Chonghou assisted.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，劉松山等軍剿張總愚於鹽山、海豐，大捷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: Liu Songshan and other forces fought Zhang Zongyu at Yanshan and Haifeng and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuyin, Liu Songshan routed Zhang Zongyu at Yanshan and Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，創設長江水師，置岳州、漢陽、湖口、瓜州四鎮總兵官。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Yangtze River flotilla was established, with regional commanders at Yuezhou, Hanyang, Hukou, and Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Yangtze flotilla was set up with commanders at Yuezhou, Hanyang, Hukou, and Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，陝軍擊退竄邠、鳳回匪。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Shaanxi forces repelled Muslim rebels raiding Bin and Feng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Shaanxi forces repelled Muslim rebels from Bin and Feng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，北山土匪犯延安，官軍失利，副將劉文華等陣沒。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Beishan bandits attacked Yan'an; government troops were defeated and Deputy Commander Liu Wenhua and others were killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Beishan bandits hit Yan'an; government troops lost and Liu Wenhua and others died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，滇軍復元謀、武定、祿勸、羅次。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yunnan forces recovered Yuanmou, Wuding, Luquan, and Luoci.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yunnan forces recovered Yuanmou, Wuding, Luquan, and Luoci.

sentences.zh: 是月，免湖南晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, arrears of tax were remitted for disturbed Huangzhou in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Hunan Huangzhou arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，郭松林等剿捻於臨邑、濱州、陽信，大捷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei: Guo Songlin and others fought the Nian at Linyi, Binzhou, and Yangxin and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiwei, Guo Songlin routed the Nian at Linyi, Binzhou, and Yangxin.

sentences.zh: 諭水師嚴扼運防。

translations.literal: An edict told the naval forces strictly to block the grain-transport defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Edict told the flotilla to guard the grain route strictly.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，桂軍復歸順。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Guangxi forces recovered Guishun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Guangxi forces recovered Guishun.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，金匪竄寧古塔界，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day guihai, gold bandits raided the Ningguta border; government troops pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai gold bandits raided Ningguta; government troops pacified them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陝軍克宜川。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Shaanxi forces took Yichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shaanxi forces took Yichuan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，張總愚犯運河岸，官軍擊敗之，捻眾多降。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhang Zongyu attacked the grain-transport river banks; government troops defeated him and many Nian surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Zongyu hit the transport river; troops defeated him and many Nian surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，又擊之於商河，大捷。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, they attacked again at Shanghe and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen they won again at Shanghe.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李雲麟褫職查辦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Li Yunlin was stripped of office for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Yunlin was stripped for investigation.

sentences.zh: 命明瑤為布倫托海辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Mingyao was ordered to serve as Office-in-Charge at Lake Bor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyao was made Office-in-Charge at Lake Bor.

sentences.zh: 浙江海塘工竣。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang seawall works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang seawall works were completed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，蠲直、魯、豫被擾各州縣田賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou: land tax was remitted in disturbed prefectures and counties of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, dingchou, land tax was remitted in disturbed Zhili, Shandong, and Henan counties.

sentences.zh: 己卯，春壽以欺飾褫職。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Chunshou was stripped of office for deception.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Chunshou was stripped for deception.

sentences.zh: 壬午，撫恤滄州等處被擾難民。

translations.literal: On day renwu, refugees in Cangzhou and other places were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Cangzhou and other refugees were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，張總愚赴水死，捻匪平。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zhang Zongyu drowned himself and the Nian bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhang Zongyu drowned and the Nian were pacified.

sentences.zh: 加李鴻章、左宗棠太子太保銜，鴻章以湖廣總督協辦大學士，丁寶楨、英翰、崇厚並加太子少保銜，復官文銜翎，晉劉銘傳一等男，郭松林一等輕車都尉，賞宋慶、善慶二等輕車都尉，劉松山黃馬褂、三等輕車都尉，郭寶昌、張曜、溫德勒克西騎都尉，黃翼升加一雲騎尉，復陳國瑞提督世職，餘升敘有差。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang and Zuo Zongtang were given the rank of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Li, as Huguang governor, also assisted the Grand Secretariat; Ding Baozhen, Ying Han, and Chonghou were all given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank; Guan Wen's rank and plume were restored; Liu Mingchuan was advanced to first-class baron; Guo Songlin to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots; Song Qing and Shan Qing were granted second-class Commandant of Light Chariots; Liu Songshan received a yellow jacket and third-class Commandant of Light Chariots; Guo Baochang, Zhang Yao, and Wendelerci were granted Commandant of Cavalry; Huang Yisheng received one additional Cloud-Cavalry Commandant; Chen Guorui's hereditary provincial commander title was restored; the rest were promoted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang and Zuo Zongtang became Grand Guardians; Li also assisted the Grand Secretariat; Ding Baozhen, Ying Han, and Chonghou became Junior Guardians; Guan Wen's honors were restored; Liu Mingchuan became a baron; Guo Songlin a Commandant of Light Chariots; Song Qing and Shan Qing second-class Commandants; Liu Songshan got a yellow jacket; others were rewarded variously.

sentences.zh: 命惇親王祭告定陵。

translations.literal: Prince Dun was ordered to offer sacrifice at the Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dun was ordered to sacrifice at the Ding Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 允彭玉麟回籍終制。

translations.literal: Peng Yulin was allowed to return home to complete mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin was allowed home to finish mourning.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，召左宗棠、李鴻章入覲。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang were summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zuo Zongtang and Li Hongzhang were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，滎澤河決。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Rongze River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Rongze River burst.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，毛昶熙言軍務漸平，宜益思寅畏，旋御史張緒楷疏請保泰持盈，及時講學，並嘉納之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Mao Changxi said military affairs were gradually calming and the court should think more of cautious reverence; soon Censor Zhang Xukai memorialized on preserving peace and holding to fullness and on studying in good time, and both were commended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Mao Changxi urged caution as war eased; Censor Zhang Xukai then urged preserving peace and study, and both were praised.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，允左宗棠請，資遣降眾回籍。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zuo Zongtang's request to send surrendered troops home with provisions was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Zuo Zongtang was allowed to send surrendered troops home.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武陟沁河堤決。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Wuzhi Qin River dike burst.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Wuzhi Qin River dike burst.

sentences.zh: 乙未，調曾國藩為直隸總督，馬新貽為兩江總督，以英桂為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Zeng Guofan was transferred to Zhili governor, Ma Xingyi to Liangjiang governor, and Ying Gui to Fujian-Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Zeng Guofan went to Zhili, Ma Xingyi to Liangjiang, and Ying Gui to Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 命彭玉麟赴江、皖會籌長江水師事宜。

translations.literal: Peng Yulin was ordered to go to Jiangsu and Anhui to plan the Yangtze flotilla.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin was sent to Jiangsu and Anhui to plan the Yangtze flotilla.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，諭蘇、皖、豫、魯各屬修圩寨，飭鄉團。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, an edict told Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong to repair dikes and stockades and organize local militia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong were told to repair dikes and organize militia.

sentences.zh: 庚子，予宋儒袁燮從祀文廟。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Song Neo-Confucian Yuan Xie was granted posthumous enshrinement in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yuan Xie was enshrined in the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 援黔川軍復龍里、貴定。

translations.literal: Sichuan forces aiding Guizhou recovered Longli and Guiding.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan relief troops recovered Longli and Guiding.

sentences.zh: 川軍剿越巂夷匪，勝之，俘其酋勒烏立。

translations.literal: Sichuan troops fought Yi bandits in Yuexi, defeated them, and captured their chief Lewuli.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan troops beat Yuexi Yi bandits and captured chief Lewuli.

sentences.zh: 授曾璧光貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Zeng Biguang was appointed Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Biguang became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，布倫托海變民竄烏隴古河。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, mutineers at Lake Bor fled to the Wulungu River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Lake Bor mutineers fled to the Wulungu River.

sentences.zh: 德勒克多爾濟卒。

translations.literal: Deleke Duoerji died.
translations.idiomatic: Deleke Duoerji died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，撫恤滎、鄭災民。

translations.literal: On day guimao, disaster victims in Xingyang and Zhengzhou were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Xingyang and Zhengzhou disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甘回擾白水、郃陽，陝軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Gansu Muslims harassed Baishui and Heyang; Shaanxi forces repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu Muslims harassed Baishui and Heyang; Shaanxi troops drove them back.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，援黔湘軍復甕安。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Hunan forces aiding Guizhou recovered Weng'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Hunan relief troops recovered Weng'an.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳朔，褫御史德泰職，以奏請修理園庭也。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day yisi: Censor Detai was stripped of office for memorializing to repair the imperial gardens.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, yisi new moon, Censor Detai was stripped for asking to repair the gardens.

sentences.zh: 庫守貴祥妄陳希利，發黑龍江為奴。

translations.literal: Treasury guard Gui Xiang falsely claimed profit and was sent to Heilongjiang as a slave.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury guard Gui Xiang lied about profit and was banished to Heilongjiang as a slave.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River burst.

sentences.zh: 己酉，諭明瑤等規復布倫托海舊制。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict told Mingyao and others to restore the old regulations at Lake Bor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Mingyao and others were told to restore Lake Bor's old system.

sentences.zh: 命馬新眙兼辦理通商事務大臣。

translations.literal: Ma Xingyi was also ordered to serve as Commissioner for Foreign Trade Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xingyi was also made Commissioner for Foreign Trade Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，延安土匪扈彰降。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Yan'an bandit Hu Zhang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yan'an bandit Hu Zhang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭左宗棠兼顧山西軍務。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict told Zuo Zongtang also to oversee Shanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zuo Zongtang was told also to oversee Shanxi military affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，諭吉林嚴定開墾圍荒界限。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an edict told Jilin strictly to fix the boundaries of reclamation and enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Jilin was told to fix reclamation boundaries strictly.

sentences.zh: 辛未，諭金順專辦援陝軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, an edict told Jin Shun to specialize in military affairs for aiding Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Jin Shun was told to specialize in aiding Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，免皖、蘇、魯、豫、鄂被擾積年逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, years of arrears were remitted in disturbed Anhui, Jiangsu, Shandong, Henan, and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, long arrears were remitted in disturbed Anhui, Jiangsu, Shandong, Henan, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，官軍復慶陽。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: government troops recovered Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renwu, government troops recovered Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，肅州回攻敦煌，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Suzhou Muslims attacked Dunhuang and government troops repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Suzhou Muslims attacked Dunhuang and were repelled.

sentences.zh: 諭伊勒屯等籌辦巴里坤屯田。

translations.literal: An edict told Yiletun and others to organize reclamation at Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: Edict told Yiletun and others to organize reclamation at Barkol.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，援黔川軍會復平越。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Sichuan forces aiding Guizhou jointly recovered Pingyue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Sichuan relief troops jointly recovered Pingyue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命延煦出關查辦奉天展邊事宜。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Yanshu was ordered beyond the pass to investigate Fengtian border expansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yanshu was sent beyond the pass to investigate Fengtian border expansion.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，滇軍復晉寧、呈貢。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yunnan forces recovered Jinning and Chenggong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Yunnan forces recovered Jinning and Chenggong.

sentences.zh: 是月，免浙江橫浦等場歉收灶課。

translations.literal: That month, salt-furnace tax was remitted for poor harvests at Hengpu and other fields in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhejiang Hengpu and other salt fields had furnace tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，回匪犯涇州、靈台，擊退之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: Muslim rebels attacked Jingzhou and Lingtai and were repelled.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, dingwei, Muslim rebels hit Jingzhou and Lingtai and were repelled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，文麟抵哈密，諭興辦蔡巴什湖等處屯田。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Wen Lin reached Hami and was ordered to establish reclamation at Chaibash Lake and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wen Lin reached Hami and was told to open reclamation at Chaibash Lake and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，穆圖善克河州。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Mutushan took Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Mutushan took Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 賑濟南、武定水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood disaster in Jinan and Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan and Wuding flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戍李雲麟黑龍江。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Li Yunlin was banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Yunlin was banished to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命李鴻藻仍直弘德殿及軍機。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Li Hongzao was ordered to continue duty at Hongde Hall and on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Hongzao was told to continue at Hongde Hall and the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以守科布多功，加土爾扈特郡王凌札棟魯布親王銜。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, for guarding Kobdo, Torghut Prince Ling Zhadonglubu was given princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Torghut Prince Ling Zhadonglubu was raised to prince for guarding Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 己巳，黔苗復陷興義，旋復之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Guizhou Miao again seized Xingyi and soon recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Guizhou Miao retook Xingyi and it was soon recovered.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，援黔川軍復麻哈。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: Sichuan forces aiding Guizhou recovered Ma Ha.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiaxu, Sichuan relief troops recovered Ma Ha.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，涼州總兵周盛波以不戢所部，褫職。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Liangzhou Commander Zhou Shengbo was stripped of office for failing to restrain his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Liangzhou Commander Zhou Shengbo was stripped for lax discipline.

sentences.zh: 回匪擾鄂爾多斯等旗，竄榆林。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels harassed the Ordos and other banners and fled into Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels harassed Ordos banners and fled into Yulin.

sentences.zh: 諭定安等截剿。

translations.literal: An edict told Ding An and others to intercept and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Edict told Ding An and others to intercept and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭除吏胥積弊。

translations.literal: On day renchen, an edict ordered the removal of accumulated abuses of clerks and runners.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ordered removal of clerk and runner abuses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，黔軍克都勻，賞張文德黃馬褂。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Guizhou troops took Duyun and Zhang Wende was rewarded with a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Guizhou troops took Duyun and Zhang Wende received a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 庚子，台灣英領事縱洋將掠船，踞營署，焚局庫，勒兵費。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the British consul in Taiwan let a foreign captain seize a ship, occupy the barracks, burn the offices, and extort military funds.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Taiwan's British consul let a foreign captain seize a ship, occupy barracks, burn offices, and extort troops' pay.

sentences.zh: 諭總署詰辦，飭英桂等遴員交涉。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen was ordered to investigate and Ying Gui and others were told to select officials to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen was told to investigate and Ying Gui and others to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，熱河匪平。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Rehe bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Rehe bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 免吉林雙城堡被水屯田租賦。

translations.literal: Rent and tax were remitted for flooded fields at Shuangcheng Castle in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin Shuangcheng Castle flooded fields had rent remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰朔，川軍剿西昌夷匪，連捷，各夷部降。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiachen: Sichuan troops fought Yi bandits at Xichang, won successive victories, and all Yi groups surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiachen new moon, Sichuan troops beat Xichang Yi bandits and all Yi groups surrendered.

sentences.zh: 援黔湘軍復天柱。

translations.literal: Hunan forces aiding Guizhou recovered Tianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan relief troops recovered Tianzhu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，回匪犯包頭，蒙軍失利。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Muslim rebels attacked Baotou and Mongol troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Muslim rebels attacked Baotou and Mongol troops lost.

sentences.zh: 丁未，熱河匪首彌勒僧格伏誅。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Rehe bandit leader Mile Sengge was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Rehe bandit leader Mile Sengge was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以曾國藩言川私病楚，諭籌止川鹽濟楚章程，撤局停稅。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, following Zeng Guofan's memorial that Sichuan salt was harming Hubei, an edict ordered planning to stop Sichuan salt entering Chu, withdraw the bureaus, and halt the tax.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, after Zeng Guofan said Sichuan salt harmed Hubei, an edict ordered plans to stop Sichuan salt to Chu and end the tax bureaus.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，滇軍復澂江。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Yunnan forces recovered Chengjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Yunnan forces recovered Chengjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，申諭各省禁種罌粟。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, an edict was reiterated to all provinces forbidding opium cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen all provinces were again forbidden to grow opium.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，黔苗竄擾河池，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Guizhou Miao raided Hechi and government troops repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Guizhou Miao raided Hechi and were repelled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，諭朝審緩決三次以上者並減等。

translations.literal: On day yichou, an edict said those with three or more deferred capital sentences in the winter review should all have one grade reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou those deferred three times or more in winter review were all reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 永定河工竣。

translations.literal: The Yongding River works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongding River works were completed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，麒慶罷，以慶春為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Qi Qing was dismissed and Qingchun was made Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Qi Qing was dismissed and Qingchun made Rehe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚午，劉松山剿賊大理川，大捷。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Liu Songshan fought bandits at Dalichuan and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Songshan won a great victory at Dalichuan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，截鄂餉二十一萬賑河南災。

translations.literal: On day renshen, two hundred ten thousand taels of Hubei grain funds were diverted to relieve disaster in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen 210,000 taels of Hubei grain funds were diverted to relieve Henan.

sentences.zh: 是月，免江蘇荒地糧賦，山東泰安、河南汝寧等屬被擾逋糧。

translations.literal: That month, grain taxes on Jiangsu waste land were remitted, and overdue grain taxes from disturbed districts including Tai'an in Shandong and Runing in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiangsu waste-land taxes and overdue taxes from Tai'an, Runing, and other disturbed districts were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea paid tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 八年己巳春正月癸酉朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Eighth year, jisi cycle, spring, first month, guiyou new moon: court banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Year 8, spring month 1, guiyou new moon: court banquets stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，川、湘、黔、桂各軍會剿苗匪，黔軍復長寨。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, armies of Sichuan, Hunan, Guizhou, and Guangxi jointly suppressed Miao bandits; Guizhou forces recovered Changzhai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, four provinces' armies suppressed Miao bandits and Guizhou recovered Changzhai.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，滇軍克富民。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yunnan forces took Fumin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Yunnan forces took Fumin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，劉松山等軍擊土、回各匪，敗之於清澗。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Liu Songshan and others defeated Tu and Hui bandits at Qingjian.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Liu Songshan defeated Tu and Hui bandits at Qingjian.

sentences.zh: 成祿克肅州，與楊占鰲並賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Cheng Lu took Suzhou; he and Yang Zhan'ao were both rewarded with yellow jackets.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lu took Suzhou; he and Yang Zhan'ao won yellow jackets.

sentences.zh: 甲午，滎工合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Rong riverworks were closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Rong riverworks closed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，劉松山軍敗賊于靖邊，董侍有等以鎮靜堡及靖邊降。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Liu Songshan's army defeated rebels at Jingbian; Dong Shiyou and others surrendered Zhenjing Fort and Jingbian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Songshan beat rebels at Jingbian and Dong Shiyou surrendered Jingbian.

sentences.zh: 迤西回犯昆明，岑毓英等擊退之。

translations.literal: Western Yunnan Hui attacked Kunming; Cen Yuying and others drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Western Yunnan Hui hit Kunming and Cen Yuying drove them back.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，雷正綰克涇州董家堡。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Lei Zhengguan took Dongjiabao at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Lei Zhengguan took Jingzhou's Dongjiabao.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，命袁保恆督辦西征糧饟。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: Yuan Baoheng was ordered to supervise western campaign grain and funds.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, wushen: Yuan Baoheng supervised western campaign supplies.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，林自清戕興義知縣，提督陳希祥誘誅之，賞希祥黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Third month, guiyou new moon: Lin Ziqing killed the Xingyi magistrate; Provincial Commander Chen Xixiang lured and executed him and was rewarded with a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, guiyou new moon: Lin Ziqing killed Xingyi's magistrate; Chen Xixiang executed him and won a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，援黔湘軍復鎮遠府、衛兩城。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Hunan relief forces for Guizhou recovered Zhenyuan prefecture and two district cities.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Hunan relief for Guizhou recovered Zhenyuan and two districts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，甘肅提督高連升部兵變，戕連升，部將周紹濂擊逆黨於同官，殄之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Gansu Provincial Commander Gao Liansheng's troops mutinied and killed him; subordinate Zhou Shaolian crushed the mutineers at Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Gao Liansheng's Gansu troops mutinied and Zhou Shaolian wiped them out at Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諭督撫於克復州縣慎選牧令，拊循流亡。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, governors and governors-general were instructed to choose magistrates carefully when recovering prefectures and counties and to comfort displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, recovered districts were told to pick good magistrates and aid refugees.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，回匪陷磴口。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Hui bandits took Dengkou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hui bandits took Dengkou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，吐魯番回匪犯哈密，官軍迭敗之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Turfan Hui attacked Hami; government troops repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Turfan Hui hit Hami and government troops beat them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 乙未，桂軍克憑祥。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Guangxi forces took Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Guangxi forces took Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，懿旨，大婚典禮，力崇節儉。

translations.literal: On day jihai, an imperial rescript stated that the grand wedding ceremony must uphold frugality.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the throne ordered a frugal grand wedding.

sentences.zh: 是春，免江蘇山陽、直隸安州等屬災、擾額賦，兩淮富安等場逋欠灶課。

translations.literal: That spring, disaster and disturbance taxes were remitted for Shanyang in Jiangsu, Anzhou in Zhili, and other districts; overdue salt-works levies at Fu'an and other Liang-Huai fields were also forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Jiangsu, Zhili, and Liang-Huai districts had disaster taxes and salt arrears remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯朔，迤西回陷楊林營，劉岳昭退守曲靖，嚴責之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, maoyin new moon: western Yunnan Hui took Yanglin camp; Liu Yuezhao fell back to defend Qujing and was severely rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4, maoyin new moon: Hui took Yanglin camp and Liu Yuezhao was rebuked for retreating to Qujing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，麟興以畏事褫職。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Lin Xing was stripped of office for timidity in office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Lin Xing lost office for cowardice.

sentences.zh: 以福濟為烏里雅蘇台將軍，文碩為布倫托海辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Fu Ji was made Uriankhai general; Wenshu was made Buruntokhai affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji took Uriankhai and Wenshu took Buruntokhai affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雷正綰、黃鼎軍復鎮原、慶陽。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Lei Zhengguan and Huang Ding's armies recovered Zhenyuan and Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Lei Zhengguan and Huang Ding recovered Zhenyuan and Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 援黔川軍復甕安。

translations.literal: Sichuan relief for Guizhou recovered Weng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan relief recovered Weng'an for Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，援黔湘軍會復清江。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Hunan relief for Guizhou jointly recovered Qingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hunan relief jointly recovered Qingjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，允劉銘傳乞病。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Liu Mingchuan's request to retire for illness was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Liu Mingchuan's sick leave was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免陳湜遣戍。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Chen Ni's banishment was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chen Ni was spared banishment.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山東東昌等屬逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes from Dongchang and other Shandong districts were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong's Dongchang and other districts had overdue taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，援黔湘軍復施秉，進攻黃飄賊壘，失利，按察使黃潤昌、道員鄧子垣、提督劉長槐死之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: Hunan relief for Guizhou recovered Shibing; advancing on Huang Piao's bandit fort they were defeated; Provincial Judge Huang Runchang, Circuit Intendant Deng Ziyuan, and Provincial Commander Liu Changhuai died.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, gengchen: relief recovered Shibing but failed attacking Huang Piao's fort; Huang Runchang, Deng Ziyuan, and Liu Changhuai died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，回匪陷澂江。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Hui bandits took Chengjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hui bandits took Chengjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，杜嘎爾等軍大破賊於杭錦旗。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Degar and others' armies routed rebels at Hanggin Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Degar's armies routed rebels at Hanggin.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命李鴻章赴四川察辦吳棠劾案。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Li Hongzhang was sent to Sichuan to investigate the impeachment case of Wu Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Hongzhang went to Sichuan on Wu Tang's impeachment.

sentences.zh: 申誡岑毓英任用通賊練目，苛斂民捐。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying was admonished for employing militia leaders who trafficked with rebels and for harsh levies on the people.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying was warned for rebel-tied militia leaders and harsh levies.

sentences.zh: 以馬如龍為雲南提督。

translations.literal: Ma Rulong was made Yunnan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Rulong became Yunnan commander.

sentences.zh: 丙申，官軍剿匪於保安，大捷，匪首袁大魁等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, government troops won a great victory suppressing bandits at Bao'an; bandit chief Yuan Dakui and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, troops crushed Bao'an bandits and Yuan Dakui was executed.

sentences.zh: 自春正月不雨至於是月，上頻禱祈。

translations.literal: From the first month of spring until this month there had been no rain; the Emperor prayed repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: From spring until this month there was drought and the Emperor prayed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，雨。
