translations.literal: On day dingyou, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，援軍會克尋甸。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai: relief armies jointly took Xundian.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, xinhai: relief armies took Xundian.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命董恂、崇厚辦理奧斯馬加換約。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Dong Xun and Chonghou were ordered to handle Austria-Hungary treaty revision.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Dong Xun and Chonghou handled Austria-Hungary treaty revision.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Yongding broke its banks.

sentences.zh: 戊午，予黃飄死事提督榮惟善、總兵羅志宏等世職加等。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, hereditary offices of Provincial Commander Rong Weishan, Regional Commander Luo Zhihong, and others who died fighting Huang Piao were raised one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, offices of men who died at Huang Piao were raised one grade.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，武英殿災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Wuying Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wuying Hall burned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，倭仁、徐桐、翁同龢請勤修聖德，以弭災變，上嘉納之。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Woren, Xu Tong, and Weng Tonghe urged diligent cultivation of sagely virtue to avert disasters; the Emperor commended and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Woren, Xu Tong, and Weng Tonghe urged moral self-cultivation and the Emperor accepted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭督撫考課農桑。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, governors were instructed to examine agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, governors were told to inspect farming and silk.

sentences.zh: 庚午，回匪犯阿拉善定遠營，蒙兵失利。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Hui bandits attacked Dingyuan camp in Alashan; Mongol troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hui hit Alashan's Dingyuan camp and Mongols lost.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinwei new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, xinwei new moon: solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，張曜等軍敗回匪於察漢淖爾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhang Yao and others' armies defeated Hui rebels at Chahan Nur.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhang Yao beat Hui rebels at Chahan Nur.

sentences.zh: 命吳坤修赴沿江各屬撫恤災民。

translations.literal: Wu Kunxiu was ordered to go to districts along the river to comfort disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kunxiu was sent to comfort river-district disaster victims.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，滇軍復嵩明，克白鹽井。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yunnan forces recovered Songming and took Baiyan Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Yunnan recovered Songming and took Baiyan Well.

sentences.zh: 甲申，桂軍會越南軍克九葑、洛陽等隘。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Guangxi forces with Vietnam's army took Jiuyi, Luoyang, and other passes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Guangxi and Vietnam took Jiuyi and Luoyang passes.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諭錫綸賑恤額魯特人眾。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Xilun was instructed to relieve the Ölöd populace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xilun was told to relieve the Ölöd.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朝鮮請鴨綠江北禁遊民建屋墾田。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Korea requested that north of the Yalu roaming commoners be forbidden to build houses and open fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Korea asked to ban Yalu north settlers from building and farming.

sentences.zh: 趣都興阿等妥辦。

translations.literal: Duxing'a and others were urged to handle the matter properly.
translations.idiomatic: Duxing'a and others were told to handle it.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，何琯軍敗賊於木壘河等處。

translations.literal: On day renchen, He Guan's army defeated bandits at Mulei River and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, He Guan beat bandits at Mulei River.

sentences.zh: 是月，免晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes from disturbed Huangzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huangzhou's disturbed overdue taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子朔，俄商船泊呼蘭河口，求吉、黑內地通商，諭總署按約止之，禁軍民私與貿易。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengzi new moon: a Russian merchant ship anchored at the Hulan estuary seeking inland trade in Jilin and Heilongjiang; the Zongli Yamen was instructed to stop it by treaty and private trade by soldiers and civilians was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, gengzi new moon: Russia sought Jilin-Heilongjiang trade and the Yamen stopped it by treaty.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，內監安得海出京，丁寶楨奏誅之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, eunuch An Dehai left the capital; Ding Baozhen memorialized his execution.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, An Dehai left Beijing and Ding Baozhen reported his execution.

sentences.zh: 黔匪復陷都勻。

translations.literal: Guizhou bandits again took Duyun.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou bandits retook Duyun.

sentences.zh: 丙午，桂軍會復越南高平。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Guangxi forces with others recovered Vietnam's Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Guangxi forces recovered Gaoping in Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，申諭約束太監。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict again warned restraint of eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the throne again warned restraint of eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，官軍剿平杭錦旗屬竄回。

translations.literal: On day renzi, government troops suppressed fleeing Hui in Hanggin Banner territory.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, troops cleared fleeing Hui in Hanggin lands.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，寧夏官軍剿賊失利，副將方大順陣亡。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Ningxia government troops were defeated suppressing bandits; Vice Commander Fang Dashun fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Ningxia troops lost and Fang Dashun died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，棍噶札拉參軍復布倫托海，賊首張匊等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Kungazhala's army recovered Buruntokhai; bandit chief Zhang Ju and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Kungazhala recovered Buruntokhai and Zhang Ju was executed.

sentences.zh: 己未，官軍剿達拉特旗竄匪，殄之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, government troops suppressed fleeing bandits in Dörbet Banner and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, troops wiped out bandits in Dörbet Banner.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑浙江杭、湖各屬，湖南安鄉等縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, disaster relief was given for floods in Hangzhou and Huzhou in Zhejiang and for Anxiang and other Hunan counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhejiang and Hunan flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，高台勇潰，褫成祿職，留任。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: Gaotai braves routed; Cheng Lu was stripped but kept in post.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, gengwu: Gaotai braves routed and Cheng Lu lost rank but stayed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，撥京餉三十萬濟武、漢等屬工賑。

translations.literal: On day renshen, three hundred thousand taels of Beijing funds were allocated for engineering relief in Wuhan and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, 300,000 taels went to Wuhan engineering relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，馬化龍復叛，襲陷靈州。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ma Hualong rebelled again and seized Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Ma Hualong rebelled again and took Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 官軍復威戎堡、水洛城。

translations.literal: Government troops recovered Weirong Fort and Shuiluo City.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops recovered Weirong Fort and Shuiluo City.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，滇軍復易門。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yunnan forces recovered Yimen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Yunnan forces recovered Yimen.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免暹羅補歷年貢品。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Siam was forgiven for making up overdue tribute goods from past years.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Siam was forgiven overdue tribute arrears.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，烏魯木齊匪竄哈密，何琯等擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Ürümqi bandits fled into Hami; He Guan and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Ürümqi bandits fled to Hami and He Guan beat them.

sentences.zh: 乙未，福建新造第一輪船成，命崇厚勘驗。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Fujian's first newly built steamship was completed and Chonghou was ordered to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Fujian's first steamship was finished and Chonghou inspected it.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，諭福濟等額魯特各安舊居，僧眾居阿爾泰山南，俗眾居青格里河。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Fu Ji and others were instructed that each Ölöd group should settle in its old homes: clergy south of the Altai, laymen on the Qinggeli River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Ölöd groups were settled: clergy south of Altai, laymen on Qinggeli River.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，劉松山敗回匪於吳忠堡等處。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: Liu Songshan defeated Hui rebels at Wuzhongbao and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, gengzi: Liu Songshan beat Hui at Wuzhongbao.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金順又敗之於納家徬。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Jin Shun defeated them again at Najiatang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jin Shun beat them again at Najiatang.

sentences.zh: 命楊占鰲署甘肅提督，辦肅州善後事宜。

translations.literal: Yang Zhan'ao was ordered to act as Gansu provincial commander and handle Suzhou pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhan'ao acted as Gansu commander for Suzhou pacification.

sentences.zh: 法使羅淑亞與其水師提督以兵船赴贛、鄂、川省查教案，諭所在按約待之。

translations.literal: French envoy Rochechouart and his naval commander went by warship to Jiangxi, Hubei, and Sichuan to investigate missionary cases; local officials were instructed to receive them per treaty.
translations.idiomatic: France sent warships to Jiangxi, Hubei, and Sichuan on missionary cases under treaty rules.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，雷正綰、黃鼎敗回匪於固原、鹽茶。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Lei Zhengguan and Huang Ding defeated Hui rebels at Guyuan and Yancha.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Lei Zhengguan and Huang Ding beat Hui at Guyuan and Yancha.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命毛昶熙、沈桂芬在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Mao Changxi and Shen Guifen were ordered to serve in the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Mao Changxi and Shen Guifen joined the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命文碩等會勘布倫托海分界事宜，董恂辦理美國換約。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Wenshu and others were ordered to survey Buruntokhai boundaries; Dong Xun handled American treaty revision.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wenshu surveyed Buruntokhai boundaries and Dong Xun handled the American treaty.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，滇軍復楚雄、南安、定遠。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Yunnan forces recovered Chuxiong, Nan'an, and Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yunnan recovered Chuxiong, Nan'an, and Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 劉岳昭移軍昆明。

translations.literal: Liu Yuezhao moved his army to Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuezhao moved his army to Kunming.

sentences.zh: 己未，哈密官軍剿西路回匪，大捷。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Hami government troops won a great victory suppressing western-route Hui rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hami troops crushed western-route Hui.

sentences.zh: 甲子，鳳凰城匪首王慶等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, bandit chiefs including Wang Qing of Fenghuangcheng were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wang Qing of Fenghuangcheng and other chiefs were executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，劉松山軍復靈州。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Liu Songshan's army recovered Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liu Songshan recovered Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑雲南水災，直隸旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for Yunnan and drought relief for Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yunnan floods and Zhili drought were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，茌平教匪孫上汶等謀逆，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: Chiping sect bandits Sun Shangwen and others plotted rebellion and were arrested and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, bingzi: Chiping sect plotters including Sun Shangwen were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，裁新設布倫托海辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the newly established Buruntokhai affairs commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the new Buruntokhai commissioner post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賑江寧水災。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Jiangning flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jiangning flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免科布多屬貢貂。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, tribute sable from Kobdo dependencies was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Kobdo sable tribute was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，滇軍復昆陽。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Yunnan forces recovered Kunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yunnan recovered Kunyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，甘軍復靖遠。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Gansu forces recovered Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Gansu forces recovered Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，永定河口合龍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Yongding estuary works were closed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Yongding estuary was closed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命文碩來京，改奎昌辦理分界。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Wenshu was summoned to the capital and Kuichang was changed to handle boundary affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wenshu came to Beijing and Kuichang took boundaries.

sentences.zh: 是月，免直隸東明被淹、被擾，安徽無為等州縣衛被水逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, taxes were remitted for flooded and disturbed Dongming in Zhili and for flood-overdue taxes in Wuwei and other Anhui districts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhili Dongming and Anhui Wuwei flood taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，援滇川軍克魯甸。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: Sichuan relief for Yunnan took Ludian.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, gengzi: Sichuan relief for Yunnan took Ludian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，劉松山軍攻金積堡，總兵簡敬臨等死之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Liu Songshan's army attacked Jinjibao; Regional Commander Jian Jinglin and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Liu Songshan attacked Jinjibao and Jian Jinglin died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，披楞侵佔哲孟雄各地，廓爾喀與唐古特構嫌，諭恩麟防維開導。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Bhutan seized various places in Sikkim; Gurkhas and Tibetans grew estranged; Enlin was instructed to guard, maintain order, and guide them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Bhutan occupied Sikkim territory; Nepal and Tibet quarreled; Enlin was told to defend, keep order, and mediate.

sentences.zh: 布魯克巴內閧，並諭恩麟解釋撫綏。

translations.literal: Bhutan had internal strife; Enlin was also told to explain matters and pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Bhutan fell into civil discord; Enlin was also ordered to explain and reassure.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，越南匪平。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Vietnamese bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Vietnam rebels were subdued.

sentences.zh: 諭蘇鳳文嚴申邊禁。

translations.literal: Su Fengwen was instructed to enforce border prohibitions strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Su Fengwen was told to tighten border bans.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑畿南災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, disaster relief was granted in southern Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, southern Zhili flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、越南、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Korea, Vietnam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, Vietnam, and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年庚午春正月丁卯朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Year 9, gengwu; spring, month 1, dingmao new moon: banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, spring month 1, dingmao new moon: court banquets were halted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，滇軍復祿豐。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Yunnan troops recovered Lufeng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Yunnan forces retook Lufeng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，甘軍擊敗援賊於王家甿。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Gansu troops defeated relief rebels at Wangjiameng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Gansu forces beat rebel reinforcements at Wangjiameng.

sentences.zh: 己卯，回匪陷定邊。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Muslim rebels took Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Muslim rebels seized Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，神武門木庫火，詔修省。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, a fire broke out at the Divine Martial Gate timber storehouse; an edict called for self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Shenwu Gate lumber depot burned; the throne ordered reflection and reform.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，回匪陷安定。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Muslim rebels took Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Muslim rebels seized Anding.

sentences.zh: 陝軍復定邊。

translations.literal: Shaanxi troops recovered Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi forces retook Dingbian.

sentences.zh: 甲午，馬德昭留辦潼關防務。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Ma Dezhao was retained to handle Tongguan defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Ma Dezhao stayed on to run Tongguan defenses.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，劉松山督剿金積堡回匪，中炮卒。

translations.literal: Month 2, xinchou: Liu Songshan, directing suppression of Jinji Fort Muslim rebels, was killed by cannon fire.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, xinchou: Liu Songshan died by cannon while leading the Jinji Fort campaign.

sentences.zh: 賞道員劉錦棠三品卿銜，接統其軍。

translations.literal: Brigade Commander Liu Jintang was awarded third-rank Qing rank and took over his army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang received third-rank Qing rank and succeeded to his command.

sentences.zh: 以俄官往齊齊哈爾、吉林商界務，諭富明阿、德英據約待之，毋遷就。

translations.literal: Because Russian officials were going to Qiqihar and Jilin on commercial affairs, Fuming'a and Deying were told to receive them according to treaty and not make concessions.
translations.idiomatic: With Russian officers bound for Qiqihar and Jilin trade, Fuming'a and Deying were told to treat them by treaty and yield nothing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，回匪分竄安邊、清澗，陝軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Muslim rebels scattered into Anbian and Qingjian; Shaanxi troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Muslim rebels split into Anbian and Qingjian; Shaanxi forces drove them out.

sentences.zh: 丙午，又分竄花馬池、榆林，宋慶軍剿之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, they again scattered to Huamachi and Yulin; Song Qing's army suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, they fled again to Huamachi and Yulin; Song Qing's troops chased them down.

sentences.zh: 戊申，官軍擊敗米脂竄匪。

translations.literal: On day wushen, government troops defeated rebels fleeing through Mizhi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, imperial forces beat rebels routed through Mizhi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命李鴻章赴陝西督辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Li Hongzhang was ordered to go to Shaanxi to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Li Hongzhang was sent to Shaanxi to run military affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，回匪竄同官、宜君，陝軍剿敗之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Muslim rebels fled into Tongguan and Yijun; Shaanxi troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Muslim rebels slipped into Tongguan and Yijun; Shaanxi forces beat them.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，法使因教案藉兵要挾，諭各疆吏通商大臣迅結交涉事宜。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the French envoy used the mission case to threaten with troops; all frontier officials and trade commissioners were told to settle negotiations swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, France's envoy used the mission affair to threaten force; frontier and trade officers were told to close talks fast.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，寧夏各堡降回復叛。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, surrendered Muslims at the various forts in Ningxia rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Ningxia fort Muslims who had surrendered rose again.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯朔，回匪竄準噶爾旗，馬玉昆擊敗之。

translations.literal: Month 3, dingmao new moon: Muslim rebels fled into the Dzungar banner; Ma Yukun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, dingmao new moon: Muslim rebels entered the Dzungar banner; Ma Yukun drove them back.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，雷正綰以疏防峽口，褫職留營。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Lei Zhengwan was stripped of office for lax defense of the gorge pass but kept with the army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Lei Zhengwan lost his post for weak gorge defense but remained in camp.

sentences.zh: 諭誡西征各軍貪功銳進。

translations.literal: Western campaign armies were admonished against greed for merit and reckless advance.
translations.idiomatic: Western armies were warned not to chase glory or rush ahead rashly.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，滇軍復彌渡、賓川、麗川、緬寧。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Yunnan troops recovered Midu, Binchuan, Lichuan, and Mianning.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Yunnan forces retook Midu, Binchuan, Lichuan, and Mianning.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，回匪分擾岐、鳳，李輝武擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Muslim rebels harassed Qi and Feng; Li Huiwu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Muslim rebels raided Qi and Feng; Li Huiwu beat them off.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，譚廷襄卒。

translations.literal: Summer, month 4, jiachen: Tan Tingxiang died.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, month 4, jiachen: Tan Tingxiang died.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，命崇實赴貴州，會同曾璧光查辦教案。

translations.literal: Month 5, gengwu: Chongshi was ordered to Guizhou to investigate the mission case jointly with Zeng Biguang.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, gengwu: Chongshi was sent to Guizhou with Zeng Biguang to handle the mission case.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，始允英國設置沿海各口電線。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Britain was first allowed to lay telegraph lines at the coastal treaty ports.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Britain was first permitted coastal treaty-port telegraph lines.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，援黔川軍克黃飄、白堡等苗寨。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Sichuan troops aiding Guizhou took Miao stockades including Huangpiao and Baibao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Sichuan relief forces in Guizhou took Huangpiao, Baibao, and other Miao forts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，天津人與天主教啟釁，焚毀教堂，毆斃法領事。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Tianjin people clashed with Catholics, burned churches, and beat the French consul to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Tianjin locals fought Catholics, torched churches, and killed the French consul.

sentences.zh: 命曾國藩與崇厚會商辦理。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan and Chonghou were ordered to confer on handling the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan and Chonghou were told to negotiate a settlement.

sentences.zh: 乙未，諭疆吏飭禁播謠惑眾，保護通商傳教各區。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, frontier officials were told to forbid rumor-mongering and protect treaty-trade and mission districts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, frontier officers were told to stop seditious talk and guard trade and mission zones.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章督軍入關，請調郭寶昌軍，允之。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang entered the pass to command troops and asked to transfer Guo Baochang's army; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang crossed into Shaanxi in command and got Guo Baochang's force transferred.

sentences.zh: 命崇厚為出使法國大臣。

translations.literal: Chonghou was appointed minister plenipotentiary to France.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghou was made envoy to France.

sentences.zh: 以成林署三口通商大臣。

translations.literal: Cheng Lin was made acting treaty-port trade commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lin acted as treaty-port trade commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，免直隸安州等屬逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes in Anzhou and other districts of Zhili were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, back taxes in Anzhou and other Zhili districts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，奎昌赴塔爾巴哈台，與俄使勘辦立界。

translations.literal: Month 6, wuxu: Kuichang went to Tarbagatai to survey and fix boundaries with the Russian envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, wuxu: Kuichang went to Tarbagatai to demarcate borders with Russia.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賽音諾顏部蒙兵剿回匪失利。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Mongol troops of the Sain Noyan league failed in suppressing Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Sain Noyan Mongols lost a fight against Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁未，滇軍復威遠。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Yunnan troops recovered Weiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yunnan forces retook Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命彭玉麟赴江南，會同沿江督撫整頓長江水師。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Peng Yulin was ordered to the south to reorganize the Yangtze fleet with river governors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Peng Yulin went south to overhaul the Yangtze navy with river governors.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，甘軍敗回匪於鞏昌。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Gansu troops defeated Muslim rebels at Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Gansu forces beat Muslim rebels at Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，永定河決。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Yongding River broke its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Yongding River burst.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以疏防民教啟釁，褫天津知府張光藻、知縣劉傑職，下部治罪。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, for lax prevention of the people-mission clash, Tianjin prefect Zhang Guangzao and magistrate Liu Jie were stripped and sent to the Board for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Zhang Guangzao and Liu Jie lost office for failing to stop the Tianjin clash and faced trial.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滇軍復姚州。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yunnan troops recovered Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yunnan forces retook Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命毛昶熙會同曾國藩查辦教案。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Mao Changxi was ordered to investigate the mission case jointly with Zeng Guofan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Mao Changxi joined Zeng Guofan to handle the mission case.

sentences.zh: 曾國藩言：「善全和局，為保民之道。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan said: "To preserve the whole peace settlement well is the way to protect the people.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan wrote: "Keeping the peace intact protects the people.

sentences.zh: 備御不虞，為立國之基。

translations.literal: Guarding against the unexpected is the foundation of establishing the state."
translations.idiomatic: Guarding against surprise is the foundation of the state."

sentences.zh: 」諭旨嘉勉。

translations.literal: An edict praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised him by edict.

sentences.zh: 命丁日昌赴天津幫辦洋務。

translations.literal: Ding Richang was ordered to Tianjin to assist in foreign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Richang was sent to Tianjin to help manage foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以琿春邊務事繁，加協領副都統銜，為定制。

translations.literal: Autumn, month 7, wuchen: because Hunchun frontier affairs were heavy, vice commandant rank was added to the co-commandant post as a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, month 7, wuchen: Hunchun's heavy frontier duties won the co-commandant a permanent vice commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 丙子，法使羅淑亞以曾國藩不允府、縣論抵，回京。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, French envoy Rochechouart returned to the capital because Zeng Guofan would not allow prefectural and county officials to be executed in atonement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Rochechouart left because Zeng Guofan refused to execute prefects and magistrates in atonement.

sentences.zh: 諭國藩迅緝原凶，從速辦結。

translations.literal: Guofan was told to arrest the original culprits swiftly and conclude the case.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan was told to seize the real killers and close the case quickly.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召崇厚還。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Chonghou was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Chonghou was called back.

sentences.zh: 命毛昶熙署三口通商大臣。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi was made acting treaty-port trade commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi acted as treaty-port trade commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，周盛傳等剿散北山餘匪。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Zhou Shengchuan and others dispersed the remaining rebels in the northern hills.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhou Shengchuan broke up the last northern-hill rebels.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，諭曰：「海上水師，與江上水師截然不同。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, an edict said: "Coastal fleets differ entirely from river fleets.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, an edict said: "Sea fleets are wholly unlike river fleets.

sentences.zh: 欲捍外侮圖自強，非二十年之久，未易收效。

translations.literal: To resist foreign insult and seek strength, twenty years are needed before results come easily.
translations.idiomatic: Beating foreign pressure and building strength needs twenty years before results show.

sentences.zh: 然因事端艱鉅，畏縮不為，則永無自強之日。

translations.literal: Yet if one shrinks from acting because affairs are grave, there will never be a day of strength.
translations.idiomatic: Yet shrinking from hard tasks means strength will never come.

sentences.zh: 近年內外臣工，值事急時，徒事張皇。

translations.literal: In recent years, officials at court and in the provinces panic when crises come.
translations.idiomatic: Lately court and provincial officials only panic in emergencies.

sentences.zh: 禍患略平，又為苟安之計。

translations.literal: When troubles ease slightly, they plan only for temporary peace.
translations.idiomatic: When danger fades, they settle for easy peace.

sentences.zh: 即創立戰守章程，而奉行不力，使朝廷謀議均屬具文。

translations.literal: Even battle-and-defense rules are made but not enforced, so court deliberations become empty paper.
translations.idiomatic: Battle rules are drafted but not enforced, so court plans stay on paper.

sentences.zh: 積習因循，焦憂曷釋。

translations.literal: Deep habits of delay—how can anxious worry be dispelled?
translations.idiomatic: Old habits of delay—how can the throne's worry lift?

sentences.zh: 茲閩、滬兩廠輪船告成，馬新貽、丁日昌、英桂、沈葆楨各擇統將出洋，窮年練習，以備不虞。

translations.literal: Now Fuzhou and Shanghai shipyards have launched steamers; Ma Xinyi, Ding Richang, Ying Gui, and Shen Baozhen will each choose commanders to go to sea and train year-round against contingencies.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou and Shanghai yards have launched steamers; Ma Xinyi, Ding Richang, Ying Gui, and Shen Baozhen must pick sea commanders for year-round drill.

sentences.zh: 廣東亦應籌備輪船，瑞麟、李福泰務切實辦理。

translations.literal: Guangdong should also prepare steamers; Ruilin and Li Futai must handle this earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong must ready steamers too; Ruilin and Li Futai are to act in earnest.

sentences.zh: 將校有熟諳風濤沙線者，隨時擇保，即山野中或長於海戰，亦當隨時物色，量材超擢。

translations.literal: Officers skilled in winds, waves, and shoals should be recommended at any time; even men from remote hills who excel at sea fighting should be sought and promoted by talent.
translations.idiomatic: Recommend officers who know winds, tides, and shoals; even hill men skilled at sea war should be found and promoted.

sentences.zh: 各督撫其統籌全局，以副委任。

translations.literal: All governors-general and governors must coordinate the whole and fulfill their charge."
translations.idiomatic: Every governor-general and governor must plan the whole and meet this charge."

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，南路甘軍復渭源、狄道。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, southern-route Gansu troops recovered Weiyuan and Didao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, southern Gansu forces retook Weiyuan and Didao.

sentences.zh: 是月，免晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes in Huangzhou disturbed by rebels were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huangzhou back taxes lost to rebel raids were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，汝陽人張汶祥刺殺馬新貽。

translations.literal: Month 8, dingyou: Zhang Wenxiang of Ruyang assassinated Ma Xinyi.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, dingyou: Ruyang's Zhang Wenxiang killed Ma Xinyi.

sentences.zh: 命曾國藩為兩江總督，李鴻章調直隸總督，李瀚章為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was made Liangjiang governor-general; Li Hongzhang was transferred to Zhili governor-general; Li Hanzhang became Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan took Liangjiang; Li Hongzhang moved to Zhili; Li Hanzhang became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，設黃河水師。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, a Yellow River naval force was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a Yellow River flotilla was set up.

sentences.zh: 庚子，北山匪首李凡覺伏誅。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, northern-hills rebel leader Li Fanjue was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, northern-hill chief Li Fanjue was put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命張之萬會同魁玉訊張汶祥。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Zhang Zhiwan was ordered to interrogate Zhang Wenxiang jointly with Kui Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhang Zhiwan and Kui Yu were to try Zhang Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，召毛昶熙還。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Mao Changxi was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Mao Changxi was called back.

sentences.zh: 命李鴻章會曾國藩查辦天津教案。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was ordered to investigate the Tianjin mission case with Zeng Guofan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang joined Zeng Guofan to handle the Tianjin mission case.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，桂軍剿平安邊、河陽賊匪，梁添錫伏誅。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Guangxi troops pacified bandits in Ping'an and Heyang; Liang Tianxi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Guangxi forces cleared Ping'an and Heyang bandits; Liang Tianxi was executed.

sentences.zh: 允越南進方物及馴象。

translations.literal: Vietnam was allowed to present local products and tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam could send local goods and trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 己未，命李成謀為新設輪船統領。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Chengmou was appointed commander of the newly established steamer fleet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Chengmou commanded the new steamer fleet.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，滇軍復新興。

translations.literal: Month 9, wuchen: Yunnan troops recovered Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, wuchen: Yunnan forces retook Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諭崇實仍赴遵義辦教案。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Chongshi was told to proceed to Zunyi to handle the mission case.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Chongshi was told to go to Zunyi for the mission case.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，治天津民教啟釁罪，張光藻、劉傑遣戍，誅逞兇殺害之犯十五人。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, penalties for the Tianjin people-mission clash were imposed: Zhang Guangzao and Liu Jie were banished; fifteen men who murdered were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Tianjin clash was judged: Zhang Guangzao and Liu Jie were exiled; fifteen killers were executed.

sentences.zh: 是秋，川東、荊州、熱河被水，賑撫之。

translations.literal: That autumn, eastern Sichuan, Jingzhou, and Rehe suffered floods and were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That fall, eastern Sichuan, Jingzhou, and Rehe were flooded and relieved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，沈葆楨丁憂，命百日後仍經理船政。

translations.literal: Winter, month 10, yiwei: Shen Baozhen entered mourning; after a hundred days he was to resume managing the shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, month 10, yiwei: Shen Baozhen mourned his father; after a hundred days he would return to the shipyard.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命劉銘傳督辦陝西軍務。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Liu Mingchuan was ordered to supervise Shaanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Mingchuan was put in charge of Shaanxi military affairs.

sentences.zh: 諭嚴禁四川州縣苛派。

translations.literal: Sichuan prefectures and counties were strictly forbidden excess levies.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan officials were strictly barred from harsh extra levies.

sentences.zh: 撥款續賑北山難民。

translations.literal: Funds were allocated for further relief of northern-hills refugees.
translations.idiomatic: More funds went to relieve northern-hill refugees.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以江北漕船阻淺，由陸路轉運臨清。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, because Jiangbei grain boats were grounded in shallows, transport to Linqing went by land.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, shallow water blocked Jiangbei grain boats, so grain moved overland to Linqing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，天津製造局成。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Tianjin Arsenal was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Tianjin Arsenal was finished.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，日本請立約通商，允總署遴員議約。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Japan asked for a treaty and trade; the Zongli Yamen was allowed to choose officers to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Japan sought treaty trade; the Zongli Yamen could pick negotiators.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免科布多貢貂。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Kobdo's tribute sable was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Kobdo's sable tribute was waived.

sentences.zh: 壬子，裁三口通商大臣，命直隸總督經理，如南洋大臣例，給欽差大臣關防。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the treaty-port trade commissioner post was abolished; the Zhili governor-general was to manage it like the Nanyang commissioner, with imperial commissioner seal.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the treaty-port commissioner was cut; Zhili's governor-general took the role with an imperial seal, as in the south.

sentences.zh: 嚴諭疆吏慎密交涉，有漏泄者立誅之。

translations.literal: Frontier officials were sternly warned to conduct negotiations secretly; leaks would mean immediate execution.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officers were warned to keep talks secret; leakers would be executed at once.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以水旱疊見，詔修省。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because floods and drought came in succession, an edict called for self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, repeated flood and drought brought an edict of reflection.

sentences.zh: 戊午，移周盛傳軍衛畿輔。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zhou Shengchuan's army was moved to guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhou Shengchuan's troops were shifted to guard the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 陝回禹生彥等竄平番，官軍失利，提督張萬美等死之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Muslims Yu Shengyan and others fled into Pingfan; government troops were defeated and Regional Commander Zhang Wanmei and others died.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shengyan's Shaanxi Muslims entered Pingfan; imperial troops lost and Commander Zhang Wanmei and others fell.

sentences.zh: 庚申，設直隸津海關道。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Zhili Tianjin Maritime Customs circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Zhili Tianjin Maritime Customs post was created.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠各軍克漢伯等堡，合圍金積堡。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang's various armies captured Hanbo and other forts and jointly besieged Jinjibao.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang's troops took Hanbo and other forts and closed in on Jinjibao.

sentences.zh: 閏十月乙丑，俄使倭良嘎哩來京。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, day yichou: Russian envoy Woliangga'li came to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the intercalary tenth month, Russian envoy Woliangga'li arrived in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，湘潭會匪平。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xiangtan secret-society bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Xiangtan secret-society rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，滇軍復永北、鶴慶、鎮南、楚雄。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Yunnan troops recovered Yongbei, Heqing, Zhennan, and Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yunnan forces retook Yongbei, Heqing, Zhennan, and Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 回匪陷烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Hui rebels took Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Hui rebels captured Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Yongding River closure was joined.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Yongding River works were closed.

sentences.zh: 諭曾國藩籌河運。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was instructed to plan river transport.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Zeng Guofan to arrange river transport.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，越南吳亞終等伏誅。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wu Yazhong and others of Vietnam were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Vietnam's Wu Yazhong and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，命鄭敦謹會鞫張汶祥獄。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi: Zheng Dunjin was ordered to join in trying Zhang Wenxiang's case.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the eleventh month, Zheng Dunjin was ordered to try Zhang Wenxiang's case.

sentences.zh: 尋定讞，磔張汶祥於江寧。

translations.literal: The verdict was soon fixed and Zhang Wenxiang was dismembered at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: The case was soon decided and Zhang Wenxiang was executed at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，回匪竄涼州，副將謝元興陣沒，王仁和擊退之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Hui rebels raided Liangzhou; Vice Commander Xie Yuanxing fell in battle and Wang Renhe drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Hui rebels struck Liangzhou; Xie Yuanxing was killed and Wang Renhe repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，援黔湘軍復台拱。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Hunan relief troops for Guizhou recovered Tai Gong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Hunan relief forces retook Tai Gong in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，福濟、榮全以匪入烏里雅蘇台，褫職留任。

translations.literal: Day wushen: because bandits entered Uliastai, Fu Ji and Rong Quan were stripped of office but kept at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Fu Ji and Rong Quan lost their posts but stayed on duty after Uliastai was overrun.

sentences.zh: 命曾國藩兼通商大臣。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was also made superintendent of trade.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was also made trade superintendent.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，甘肅總兵周東興侵賑，命斬於軍前。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Gansu regional commander Zhou Dongxing embezzled relief grain and was ordered beheaded before the army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Zhou Dongxing was beheaded in camp for embezzling relief grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，劉坤一以漏泄密諭，褫職留任。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Liu Kunyi was censured for leaking secrets; his office was stripped but he remained on duty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Liu Kunyi was demoted yet kept in post for leaking secrets.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，諭嚴禁河工偷減侵蝕諸弊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: an edict strictly forbade skimming, graft, and erosion in river works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the twelfth month, river-work graft and skimming were strictly banned.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滇軍復鄧川、浪穹。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Yunnan troops recovered Dengchuan and Langqiong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yunnan forces retook Dengchuan and Langqiong.

sentences.zh: 回目馬源發戕提督丁賢發等，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Hui leader Ma Yuanfa killed Regional Commander Ding Xianfa and others; he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuanfa killed Ding Xianfa and other officers and was then captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 是冬，免貴州興義等州縣衛、陝西綏德等州縣災擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That winter, overdue taxes were remitted in disaster-struck districts of Xingyi and other prefectures and guards in Guizhou and in Suide and other counties in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, back taxes were forgiven in Guizhou's Xingyi area and Shaanxi's Suide district.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年辛未春正月辛卯朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Tenth year, xinwei: spring, first month, day xinmao new moon: the birthday banquet was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, xinwei, the new-year banquet was suspended on the first month's xinmao new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，官軍克河西王甿賊壘，賞金順黃馬褂，加張曜一雲騎尉。

translations.literal: Day renchen: government troops captured the rebel bastions of Hexi Wang Meng; Jin Shun was granted a yellow jacket; Zhang Yao received an additional Cloud Cavalry Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Hexi Wang Meng fell; Jin Shun got a yellow jacket and Zhang Yao an extra Cloud Cavalry Commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，黔軍平貴定等處賊壘，克都勻，賞提督林從泰、總兵何雄輝黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Guizhou troops pacified rebel strongholds around Guiding and captured Duyun; Brigadier Lin Congtai and Regional Commander He Xionghui were granted yellow jackets.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Guizhou troops cleared Guiding and took Duyun; Lin Congtai and He Xionghui received yellow jackets.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諭馮子材赴太平進剿牧馬、諒山匪。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Feng Zicai was instructed to advance to Taiping to suppress the Pasture Horse and Lang Son bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Feng Zicai was sent to Taiping against Pasture Horse and Lang Son rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，官文卒。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Guan Wen died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Guan Wen died.

sentences.zh: 是月，免直隸安州等屬被水額賦。

translations.literal: That month, land tax quotas were remitted in Anzhou and other districts of Zhili struck by flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood-hit Anzhou and other Zhili districts had taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，劉錦棠等軍克金積堡，匪首馬化龍等伏誅，加左宗棠一騎都尉，賞劉錦棠雲騎尉、黃馬褂，開復雷正綰處分，及陳湜原官，賞黃鼎、金運昌黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: Liu Jintang's army captured Jinjibao; rebel leaders Ma Hualong and others were executed; Zuo Zongtang was given an additional Commandant of Cavalry; Liu Jintang was granted Cloud Cavalry Commander and a yellow jacket; Lei Zhengwan's punishments were lifted, as were Chen Shi's former offices; Huang Ding and Jin Yunchang received yellow jackets.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the second month, Jinjibao fell and Ma Hualong was executed; Zuo Zongtang, Liu Jintang, Lei Zhengwan, Chen Shi, Huang Ding, and Jin Yunchang were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 置就撫陝回於華亭之化平川，設通判、都司以綏靖之。

translations.literal: Surrendered Shaanxi Muslims were resettled at Huapingchuan in Huating; an assistant prefect and a colonel were stationed to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Pacified Shaanxi Muslims were settled at Huapingchuan with an assistant prefect and colonel to keep order.

sentences.zh: 前知靈州彭慶章坐為賊主謀，處斬。

translations.literal: Former Lingzhou magistrate Peng Qingzhang was executed for plotting for the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Ex-magistrate Peng Qingzhang of Lingzhou was executed for aiding rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬午，獲叛將宋景詩，誅之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the rebel general Song Jingshi was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, rebel general Song Jingshi was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，調江蘇按察使應寶時赴津，籌辦日本通商事。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Jiangsu surveillance commissioner Ying Baoshi was transferred to Tianjin to handle Japanese trade affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Ying Baoshi went to Tianjin to manage Japanese trade.

sentences.zh: 命瑞常為大學士，文祥協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Rui Chang was made Grand Secretary; Wen Xiang was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Chang became grand secretary and Wen Xiang was ordered to assist.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，金順等軍克寧夏，匪首馬萬選伏誅。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: Jin Shun's army captured Ningxia; rebel leader Ma Wanxuan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the third month, Jin Shun took Ningxia and Ma Wanxuan was executed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，滇軍復澂江，克江那土城，匪首馬和等伏誅。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Yunnan troops recovered Chengjiang and captured Jiangna indigenous walled city; rebel leaders Ma He and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Yunnan forces retook Chengjiang, took Jiangna, and executed Ma He and others.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，普使李福斯致國書，以德意志各國及自主之三漢謝城共復一統，受尊稱為德意志皇帝，復書賀之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Prussian envoy Li Fusi presented a state letter: the German states and the three autonomous Hanse cities had been reunited and their ruler received the title German Emperor; a reply congratulating them was sent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Prussian envoy Li Fusi announced German unification and the new emperor; Beijing sent congratulations.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以倭仁為文華殿大學士，瑞常為文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Woren was made Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall and Rui Chang Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Woren and Rui Chang were made grand secretaries of Wenhua and Wenyuan halls.

sentences.zh: 自春初至於是月，上連祈雨。

translations.literal: From early spring until this month the Emperor continually prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: From early spring through this month the Emperor kept praying for rain.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，雨。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，援黔湘軍復新城、岩門司等城，克高坡等苗寨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: Hunan relief troops for Guizhou recovered Xincheng, Yanmensi, and other cities and captured the Gaopo and other Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fourth month, Hunan relief forces retook Xincheng and Yanmensi and seized Gaopo Miao stockades.

sentences.zh: 己巳，寧夏納家徬回眾降。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Najia Tangut Muslim communities of Ningxia surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ningxia's Najia Muslims surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陝回竄擾平番、碾伯，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Shaanxi Muslims raided Pingfan and Minhe; government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Shaanxi Muslims struck Pingfan and Minhe and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，倭仁卒。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Woren died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Woren died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜梁耀樞等三百二十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Liang Yaoshu and 320 others were granted jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Liang Yaoshu and 320 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 築大沽、北塘炮台。

translations.literal: Batteries were built at Dagu and Beitang.
translations.idiomatic: Forts were built at Dagu and Beitang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，福濟革職，以金順為烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Fu Ji was dismissed from office; Jin Shun was made general of Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Fu Ji was dismissed and Jin Shun became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，回匪復竄擾賽音諾顏部，焚掠固爾班賽汗等處。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Hui rebels again raided the Sainoino Banner territory, burning and plundering at Gurban Saihan and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Hui rebels raided Sainoino banners and burned Gurban Saihan.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin new moon: rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month's gengyin new moon, it rained.

sentences.zh: 乙未，左宗棠請禁絕回民新教，不許。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Zuo Zongtang requested to ban the Muslims' New Teaching; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Zuo Zongtang's request to ban Muslim New Teaching was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，苗酋聞國興等降，八寨等城俱復。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Miao chieftain Wen Guoxing and others surrendered and Ba Zhai and other cities were all recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Wen Guoxing's Miao surrendered and Ba Zhai and other towns were retaken.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，回匪擾烏拉特，杜嘎爾、薩薩布軍合擊之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Hui rebels harassed Urat; the troops of Duga'er and Sasabu jointly attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Hui rebels hit Urat and Duga'er and Sasabu attacked together.

sentences.zh: 丙午，援黔湘軍復丹江、凱里等城，賞蘇元春黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Hunan relief troops for Guizhou recovered Danjiang, Kaili, and other cities; Su Yuanchun was granted a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Hunan relief forces retook Danjiang and Kaili; Su Yuanchun got a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以李世忠尋仇斗很，陳國瑞演劇生事，褫世忠職，降國瑞都司，並勒回籍，畀有司管束。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: because Li Shizhong sought revenge and brawled and Chen Guorui produced plays and caused trouble, Li Shizhong was stripped of office, Chen Guorui was reduced to colonel, and both were ordered back to their native places under local control.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Li Shizhong and Chen Guorui were punished and sent home under local restraint.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鄭親王承志有罪，褫爵逮訊。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Prince Cheng Zhi Zhi Cheng was found guilty; his princedom was stripped and he was arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Prince Cheng was stripped of rank and arrested.

sentences.zh: 命李鴻章辦日本商約，應寶時、陳欽為幫辦。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was ordered to handle the Japanese commercial treaty; Ying Baoshi and Chen Qin were made assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was ordered to negotiate the Japanese treaty with Ying Baoshi and Chen Qin assisting.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，金順乞假守制葬親。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Jin Shun begged leave for mourning to bury his parents.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Jin Shun asked mourning leave to bury his parents.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 己未，滇軍復雲龍。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Yunnan troops recovered Yunlong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yunnan forces retook Yunlong.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the sixth month, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 益陽等處會匪平。

translations.literal: Secret-society bandits in Yiyang and elsewhere were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Secret-society rebels in Yiyang and nearby areas were pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，陝回白彥虎結西寧回眾擾河州。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Shaanxi Muslim Bai Yanhu united with Xining Muslim communities to harass Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Bai Yanhu and Xining Muslims raided Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，黔軍克永寧、鎮寧、歸化苗寨，破郎岱、水城各峒寨。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Guizhou troops captured Yongning, Zhenning, and the Guihua Miao stockades and broke the stockades of Langdai and Shuicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Guizhou troops took Yongning, Zhenning, and Guihua Miao stockades and stormed Langdai and Shuicheng.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命瑞麟為大學士，仍留兩廣總督任。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Rui Lin was made Grand Secretary while remaining governor-general of the two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Rui Lin became grand secretary and stayed governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，阜陽匪擾沈丘、汝陽，官軍捕誅之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Fuyang bandits harassed Shenqiu and Ruyang; government troops captured and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Fuyang bandits raided Shenqiu and Ruyang and were caught and killed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以廣東盜賊橫行，諭飭嚴緝。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: because Guangdong bandits ran rampant, an edict ordered strict suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, an edict ordered harsh suppression of Guangdong bandits.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，德宗生於醇邸。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Dezong Emperor was born at Prince Chun's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the future Dezong was born at Prince Chun's mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑天津災。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Tianjin disaster relief was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Tianjin disaster relief was issued.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑朔，桂軍剿越南竄匪，克長慶，斬匪首趙雄才。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jichou new moon: Guangxi troops suppressed bandits who had fled from Vietnam, captured Changqing, and beheaded the rebel leader Zhao Xiongcai.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's jichou new moon, Guangxi troops killed Zhao Xiongcai and took Changqing from Vietnamese raiders.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，杜嘎爾軍剿賊於布拉特，勝之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Duga'er's army defeated bandits at Blat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Duga'er's force beat rebels at Blat.

sentences.zh: 甲午，永定河復決。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Yongding River burst again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Yongding River broke again.

sentences.zh: 丙申，穆圖善赴北山剿賊。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Mutu Shan went to Beishan to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Mutu Shan marched to Beishan against bandits.

sentences.zh: 金運昌軍剿烏拉特竄匪，勝之。

translations.literal: Jin Yunchang's army defeated bandits who had fled into Urat.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Yunchang's troops beat Urat raiders.

sentences.zh: 丁未，河內沁河決。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Qin River within Hanoi burst.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Qin River in Hanoi broke its banks.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，昌圖賊匪竄擾，都興阿遣軍剿平之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Changtu bandits raided and harassed; Du Xing'a sent troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Changtu bandits raided and Du Xing'a sent troops to crush them.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，以副都統慶至襲封鄭親王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: Vice Metropolitan Banner Commander Qing Zhi inherited the princehood of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the eighth month, Qing Zhi succeeded as Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，桂軍克安世賊寨，追剿太原竄匪，蘇國漢赴廣東乞降。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Guangxi troops captured the Anshi rebel stockade and pursued bandits who had fled into Taiyuan; Su Guohan went to Guangdong to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Guangxi troops took Anshi and pursued Taiyuan raiders; Su Guohan surrendered in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔各省設局收養流寓孤寡。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered each province to establish offices to receive wandering orphans and widows.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, provinces were told to open shelters for homeless orphans and widows.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，革高郵徵糧弊習。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: the corrupt practice of grain levies at Gaoyou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month, Gaoyou's abusive grain levies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，甘軍克康家崖要隘。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Gansu troops captured the Kangjiaya strategic pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Gansu forces took Kangjiaya pass.

sentences.zh: 趣榮全赴伊犁。

translations.literal: Rong Quan was urgently sent to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan was ordered to hurry to Ili.

sentences.zh: 給劉銘傳假三月。

translations.literal: Liu Mingchuan was granted three months' leave.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan was given three months' leave.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，諭奉、吉整頓吏治，嚴緝盜賊。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict ordered Fengtian and Jilin to rectify official conduct and strictly hunt bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Fengtian and Jilin were told to clean up government and suppress bandits.

sentences.zh: 命恩錫往上海辦奧國換約。

translations.literal: En Xi was ordered to proceed to Shanghai to conduct the Austrian treaty exchange.
translations.idiomatic: En Xi was sent to Shanghai for the Austrian treaty exchange.

sentences.zh: 丁未，喬松年等會堵侯家林決口。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Qiao Songnian and others joined in blocking the breach at Houjialin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Qiao Songnian and others worked to close the Houjialin breach.

sentences.zh: 是秋，賑順直各屬及菏澤等州縣災，免濮州被水、晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That autumn, disaster relief was given in various districts of Zhili and in Heze and other counties; overdue taxes were remitted in Puzhou for flood and in Huangzhou for disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Zhili and Heze were relieved; Puzhou flood taxes and Huangzhou disturbance arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，達爾濟以撤營縱賊，褫職逮治。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuwu new moon: Daerji was stripped of office and arrested for trial for withdrawing camps and letting bandits escape.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's wuwu new moon, Daerji was arrested for pulling back camps and letting rebels escape.

sentences.zh: 命曹克忠接統劉銘傳軍，赴肅州防剿。

translations.literal: Cao Kezhong was ordered to take over Liu Mingchuan's army and proceed to Suzhou for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Kezhong was ordered to command Liu Mingchuan's force at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以湖南匪變，命李鴻章查辦。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: because of a Hunan bandit uprising, Li Hongzhang was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Li Hongzhang was sent to investigate a Hunan rebel outbreak.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命景廉為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Jing Lian was made Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Jing Lian became Urumqi commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔免伊犁被脅官吏軍民等罪。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict pardoned officials, soldiers, and people of Ili who had been coerced.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, coerced Ili officials, troops, and civilians were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 以參領貢果爾接統達爾濟軍。

translations.literal: Staff Captain Gongguo'er took over Daerji's army.
translations.idiomatic: Staff Captain Gongguo'er assumed Daerji's command.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，甘軍克河州，禹得彥等降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi: Gansu troops captured Hezhou; Yu Deyan and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the eleventh month, Gansu forces took Hezhou and Yu Deyan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁未，西寧回匪竄烏拉特及中衛，張曜軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Xining Hui rebels fled into Urat and Zhongwei; Zhang Yao's army drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Xining Hui rebels raided Urat and Zhongwei and Zhang Yao repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，肅州回匪復犯敦煌，文麟援剿之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Suzhou Hui rebels again invaded Dunhuang; Wen Lin reinforced the suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Suzhou Hui rebels struck Dunhuang and Wen Lin counterattacked.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，予先儒張履祥從祀文廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: the earlier Confucian Zhang Lvxiang was granted posthumous sacrifice in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month, Zhang Lvxiang was enshrined in the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，香山匪徒曾大鵝幅等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Xiangshan sect leader Zeng Da'e Fu and others raised rebellion; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Xiangshan rebel Zeng Da'e Fu and others were captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、越南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Vietnam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年壬申春正月丙戌朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, renshen: spring, first month, day bingxu new moon: the birthday banquet was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, renshen, the new-year banquet was suspended on the first month's bingxu new moon.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以紀年開秩諭減刑。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict ordered reduced punishments because of the new year's opening of the chronicle.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, punishments were reduced for the new reign year.

sentences.zh: 文碩以乞病褫職。

translations.literal: Wen Shuo was stripped of office for feigning illness to beg leave.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shuo lost his post for falsely claiming illness to resign.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，桂軍復越南從化，克鎮山。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Guangxi troops recovered Conghua in Vietnam and took Zhenshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Guangxi forces retook Vietnamese Conghua and captured Zhenshan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，甘軍連破甘坪、大貝坪等處賊壘，進攻太子寺。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Gansu troops successively stormed rebel camps at Ganping, Dabeiping, and elsewhere and advanced on Taizisi.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Gansu forces broke camps at Ganping and Dabeiping and pressed Taizisi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，黔軍克清平、黃平、重安。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Guizhou troops took Qingping, Huangping, and Chong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Guizhou forces captured Qingping, Huangping, and Chong'an.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，援黔湘軍克黃飄、白堡苗寨。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Hunan relief troops in Guizhou took the Huangpiao and Baibao Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Hunan auxiliaries in Guizhou took Huangpiao and Baibao Miao forts.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命侍郎崇厚、太常寺少卿夏家鎬在總理各國事務衙門行走。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Vice Minister Chonghou and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xia Jiagao were ordered to serve at the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chonghou and Xia Jiagao were assigned to the Zongli Yamen.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，允江蘇辦米試行河運，漕白二糧仍由海運。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: Jiangsu was allowed to trial grain transport by river; tribute and white grain still went by sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, Jiangsu could trial river grain transport while sea transport continued for tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，曾國藩卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zeng Guofan died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zeng Guofan died and was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，褫劉銘傳職，以前功仍留一等男爵。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Liu Mingchuan was stripped of office but, for past merit, still kept the rank of first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Liu Mingchuan lost his post yet retained first-class baron for prior service.

sentences.zh: 庚午，起彭玉麟巡閱長江水師。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Peng Yulin was recalled to inspect the Yangtze flotilla.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Peng Yulin resumed inspection of the Yangtze flotilla.

sentences.zh: 甲申，侯家林決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the breach at Houjialin was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Houjialin breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 越南匪首蘇國漢等伏誅。

translations.literal: Vietnamese rebel leaders Su Guohan and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Su Guohan and other Vietnamese rebel chiefs were put to death.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑四川各屬災。

translations.literal: That month, disaster relief was given to all subordinate districts of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Sichuan prefectures received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉朔，黔軍復貞豐。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day yiyou: Guizhou troops recovered Zhenfeng.
translations.idiomatic: At the third-month new moon, yiyou, Guizhou forces retook Zhenfeng.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，甘軍剿太子寺回匪失利，提督傅先榮、徐文秀死之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Gansu troops suffered defeat suppressing Muslim rebels at Taizisi; Generals Fu Xianrong and Xu Wenxiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Gansu forces were beaten at Taizisi; Fu Xianrong and Xu Wenxiu fell.

sentences.zh: 褫提督楊世俊黃馬褂，降參將。

translations.literal: General Yang Shijun was stripped of his yellow jacket and demoted to vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shijun lost his yellow jacket and was reduced to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 甲午，免達爾濟等罪，仍褫職效力。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Da'erji and others were pardoned of crime but still stripped of rank to serve on merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Da'erji and others were forgiven yet demoted to serve in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以奉匪擾朝鮮境，嚴緝之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because Feng bandits harassed the Korean border, strict arrest was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Feng bandits on the Korean frontier drew orders for rigorous pursuit.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，瑞常卒。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Ruichang died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Ruichang died.

sentences.zh: 是春，免湖北黃陂、直隸安州、甘肅河州等處被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That spring, overdue taxes were remitted in Huangpi, Hubei, Anzhou, Zhili, Hezhou, Gansu, and other districts disturbed by war.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, war-torn districts including Huangpi, Anzhou, and Hezhou had overdue taxes waived.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，回匪竄定邊、靖邊，陝軍擊退之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen: Muslim rebels fled into Dingbian and Jingbian; Shaanxi troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingchen day, Muslim rebels entered Dingbian and Jingbian and Shaanxi troops repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 己未，西寧回目馬占鰲、陝回崔三、米拉溝回目治成林等，先後乞降。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Xining Muslim chief Ma Zhan'ao, Shaanxi Muslim Cui San, and Milan'gou chief Zhichenglin successively begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Ma Zhan'ao, Cui San, and Zhichenglin each offered surrender in turn.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，停淮關傳辦活計。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Huai Pass special procurement of living needs was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Huai Pass living-procurement commissions were stopped.

sentences.zh: 諭內務府力求撙節。

translations.literal: The Imperial Household Department was instructed to practice strict economy.
translations.idiomatic: The Internal Affairs Office was told to economize rigorously.

sentences.zh: 己卯，通政司副使王維珍疏陳先意承志，孝思維則。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Vice Transmission Commissioner Wang Weizhen memorialized on anticipating the sovereign's will and filial rectitude.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Wang Weizhen memorialized on anticipating intent and filial duty.

sentences.zh: 予嚴議，尋褫職。

translations.literal: Severe censure was imposed; soon he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He was severely rebuked and soon dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是月，免貴州興義等屬被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes were remitted in Xingyi and other disturbed districts of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Guizhou districts including Xingyi had overdue taxes waived.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day jiashen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth-month new moon, jiashen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 免熱河騰圍旗民租課三年。

translations.literal: Banner rents at Tengwei in Rehe were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Rehe Tengwei banner rents were waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，自三月初旬，慈禧太后弗豫，月餘不視朝。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, since early in the third month Empress Dowager Cixi had been ill and for more than a month did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Cixi had been ill since early third month and had not held court for over a month.

sentences.zh: 至是，御史李宏謨請勤召對。

translations.literal: At this time Censor Li Hongmo asked that audiences be held frequently.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Hongmo then asked for more frequent audiences.

sentences.zh: 諭責其冒昧，嚴飭之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked his presumption and sternly warned him.
translations.idiomatic: He was rebuked for presumption and sternly admonished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，徐占彪軍剿肅回屢捷。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Xu Zhanbiao's army had repeated victories suppressing Gansu Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Xu Zhanbiao won repeated victories over Gansu Muslims.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠劾成祿糜帑遷延，命穆圖善查辦。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang impeached Cheng Lu for wasting funds and delay; Mutušan was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang charged Cheng Lu with waste and delay; Mutušan was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貴州苗匪平，賞席寶田騎都尉。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Guizhou Miao rebels were pacified; Xi Baotian was made Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Guizhou Miao rebels were pacified and Xi Baotian became Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 丙申，陝回宋全德等降。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Shaanxi Muslims Song Quande and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Song Quande and other Shaanxi Muslims surrendered.

sentences.zh: 予伊犁殉難已革尚書陳孚恩暨其眷屬旌恤加等。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were raised for the disgraced former Minister Chen Fuen, who had died at Yili, and for his family.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fuen, disgraced minister martyred at Yili, and his kin received raised posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命李鴻章為大學士，仍留直隸總督任。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Li Hongzhang was made Grand Secretary while remaining Zhili governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Li Hongzhang became Grand Secretary and kept the Zhili governorship.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，滇軍克永平及雲南。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Yunnan troops took Yongping and Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yunnan forces captured Yongping and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，朱鳳標緻仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: Zhu Fengbiao retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu day, Zhu Fengbiao retired.

sentences.zh: 命文祥為大學士，全慶協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Wen Xiang was made Grand Secretary; Quanqing was made assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xiang became Grand Secretary and Quanqing assistant Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭停本年秋審、朝審句決。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, autumn review and court capital sentences were suspended for this year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, this year's autumn and court executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 以單懋謙協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Shan Maoqian was made assistant Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Maoqian became assistant Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未朔，滇軍會克興義。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, new moon on day guiwei: Yunnan allied troops took Xingyi.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh-month new moon, guiwei, Yunnan allied forces captured Xingyi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，免廓爾喀例貢。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Nepal's routine tribute was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Nepal's regular tribute was excused.

sentences.zh: 賑達木蒙古及三十九族被災兵民。

translations.literal: Disaster relief was given to troops and civilians among the Dorbod Mongols and the Thirty-nine Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Dorbod Mongols and the Thirty-nine Banners received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，回匪竄擾寧夏西路及阿拉善旗，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Muslim rebels raided western Ningxia and Alashan; government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Muslim rebels hit western Ningxia and Alashan and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，直隸呈進瑞麥，御史邊寶泉疏論之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Zhili presented auspicious wheat; Censor Bian Baoquan memorialized on it.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhili offered auspicious wheat and Censor Bian Baoquan criticized it.

sentences.zh: 諭李鴻章勤恤民隱，補救偏災，毋鋪張瑞應。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was told to care for the people's hardships, remedy partial disasters, and not boast auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was warned to relieve distress, fix local disasters, and not trumpet omens.

sentences.zh: 庚子，永定河北下汛溢。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the lower Yongding reach flooded on the north bank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the lower Yongding north bank burst.

sentences.zh: 是月，免湖南晃州被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That month, overdue taxes were remitted at Huangzhou, Hunan, after disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huangzhou in Hunan had disturbed districts' taxes waived.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，截江北漕米十萬餘石賑畿輔被水災民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: more than one hundred thousand shi of Jiangbei tribute rice were diverted to relieve flood victims in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu day, over 100,000 shi of Jiangbei tribute rice fed flood victims around the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金順以遷延罷，常順署烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Jin Shun was dismissed for delay; Chang Shun acted as Uliastai General.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Jin Shun was removed for delay and Chang Shun acted at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以單懋謙為大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Shan Maoqian was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Shan Maoqian became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，滇軍克趙州、蒙化並大理上下關，賞楊玉科、李維述黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiwei: Yunnan troops took Zhao Prefecture, Menghua, and the upper and lower passes of Dali; Yang Yuke and Li Weishu were given yellow jackets.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei day, Yunnan forces took Zhao, Menghua, and Dali passes; Yang Yuke and Li Weishu won yellow jackets.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠言地產瑞麥瑞穀，諭卻之。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang reported auspicious wheat and grain from the land; an edict declined them.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang reported auspicious grain; the court refused the tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙未，冊立皇后阿魯特氏，自王大臣以次推恩加賚，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Empress Arute was invested; honors extended from princes and ministers downward; an edict was issued to the realm and general grace granted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Empress Arute was enthroned, honors cascaded through the court, and a grace edict went empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 永定河工合龍。

translations.literal: The Yongding River works were closed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongding River repairs were completed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，允彭玉麟乞病回籍，仍命每年巡閱長江水師。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Peng Yulin's request to return home on grounds of illness was granted; he was still ordered to inspect the Yangtze flotilla each year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Peng Yulin went home ill but still had to inspect the Yangtze flotilla yearly.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，榮全請令慶符招撫纏、民，英廉等馬隊駐庫爾喀喇烏蘇，酌募民勇，允之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Rong Quan's plan was approved: Qing Fu was to pacify tribal groups and civilians, Yinglian's cavalry was to garrison Kurkara-usu, and local militia were to be recruited as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Rong Quan won approval for Qing Fu to pacify tribesmen, Yinglian's horse to camp at Kurkara-usu, and selective militia levies.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，甘肅潰勇首犯馮高山等伏誅。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingsi: ringleaders of the Gansu mutinous troops, including Feng Gaoshan, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingsi day, Gansu mutiny leaders such as Feng Gaoshan were executed.

sentences.zh: 己未，加上兩宮皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, honorific titles were added for both Empress Dowagers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, both Empress Dowagers received added honorific titles.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，廣西隆安、岑溪土匪，西隆苗匪平。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, bandits in Guangxi's Long'an and Cenxi and Miao rebels in Xilong were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Long'an and Cenxi bandits and Xilong Miao rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，諭統兵大臣約束委員，治騷擾逾限者罪。

translations.literal: On day renyin, commanding generals were told to restrain their staff; those who harassed beyond limits would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, field commanders were ordered to curb staff excesses on pain of punishment.

sentences.zh: 允恭親王請，復軍機處舊制。

translations.literal: Prince Gong's request was granted to restore the Grand Council's former regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong's plea restored the old Grand Council rules.

sentences.zh: 丙子，何璟憂免，以張樹聲署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, He Jing was relieved on mourning; Zhang Shusheng acted as Liangjiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, He Jing left on mourning and Zhang Shusheng acted at Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，朝鮮匪船越境侵擾，都興阿等水師緝剿之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: Korean pirate ships crossed the border to raid; Du Xing'a and others' naval forces suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, Korean pirate ships crossed the border and Du Xing'a's fleet suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 回匪擾哈密東山，官軍剿勝之。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels harassed the eastern hills of Hami; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels troubled Hami's eastern hills and were beaten by government troops.

sentences.zh: 禁殿廷、鄉、會考試請託冒替。

translations.literal: Bribery and impersonation were forbidden in palace, provincial, and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Palace, provincial, and metropolitan exams were barred from patronage and substitution.

sentences.zh: 己卯，瓊州土匪平，誅匪首何亞萬等。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Qiongzhou bandits were pacified; bandit chiefs He Yawan and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Qiongzhou bandits were pacified and He Yawan and other chiefs were killed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，滇軍剿館驛等踞匪，迤東、迤南肅清。
