translations.literal: On day xinmao, Yunnan troops suppressed bandits holding Guanyi and other posts; eastern and southern Yunnan were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Yunnan forces cleared Guanyi bandits and pacified the east and south.

sentences.zh: 乙未，肅回竄紥薩克汗各旗，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Gansu Muslims fled into the banners of the Zasak Khans; government troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Gansu Muslims entered Zasak Khan banners and were driven away.

sentences.zh: 黔軍會克新城。

translations.literal: Guizhou allied troops took Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou allied forces captured Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 下江苗匪亂，張文德軍剿除之。

translations.literal: Lower Yangtze Miao rebels rose; Zhang Wende's army eliminated them.
translations.idiomatic: Lower Yangtze Miao rebels were crushed by Zhang Wende.

sentences.zh: 全黔底定。

translations.literal: All Guizhou was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙申，捻匪竄擾太湖，水師剿平之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Nian rebels raided Taihu; naval forces pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Nian bandits hit Taihu and the fleet suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 允軍民入哥老會者自首免罪。

translations.literal: Military and civilians who had joined the Gelaohui were allowed to confess and be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians in the Gelaohui could surrender without punishment.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，申禁各省種罌粟。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, opium cultivation was again forbidden in all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, all provinces were again forbidden to grow opium poppies.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，劉錦棠等軍剿回匪，大捷。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Liu Jintang and others won a great victory suppressing Muslim rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Liu Jintang scored a major victory over Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁未，陝軍剿陝北二道河等處竄匪，殄之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Shaanxi troops annihilated fleeing rebels in northern Shaanxi around Erdaohe and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Shaanxi forces wiped out northern rebels around Erdaohe.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章奏設招商局，試辦輪船分運江、浙漕糧。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized establishing the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company to trial steamers for dividing transport of Jiangsu and Zhejiang tribute grain.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang proposed the China Merchants Company to trial steamers for Jiangsu-Zhejiang tribute grain.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，駐藏幫辦德泰坐事褫職回旗。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: Tibetan assistant Detai was stripped of office for misconduct and returned to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Detai, assistant in Tibet, was dismissed and sent back to his banner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諭吏部、兵部、理藩院，親政後，各署有請旨及軍務摺片，均用漢文。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Boards of Civil Appointments, War, and Lifan Yuan were told that after personal rule all memorials on audience and military affairs must be in Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Civil, War, and Lifan boards were ordered to use Chinese for audience and military papers after personal rule.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，釋田興恕回。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Tian Xingwu was released to return.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Tian Xingwu was freed to go home.

sentences.zh: 丙子，左宗棠乞病，溫旨不許，己卯，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zuo Zongtang begged leave on grounds of illness; a warm edict refused; on day jimao, the joint autumn ancestral sacrifice was held.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zuo Zongtang's sick leave was refused; on jimao day came the joint autumn temple rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 十二年癸酉春正月辛巳朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, guiyou, spring, first month, new moon on day xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: Year twelve, guiyou, spring, first month, xinsi new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸未，官軍擊回匪於那瑪特吉幹昭，敗之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, government troops defeated Muslim rebels at Namatigan Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, government forces beat Muslim rebels at Namatigan Zhao.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以李宗羲為兩江總督，兼通商大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Li Zongxi was made Liangjiang governor and Superintendent of Trade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Li Zongxi became Liangjiang governor and trade superintendent.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，成祿以苛捐誣叛，褫職逮問，趣金順接統其軍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Cheng Lu was stripped and arrested for harsh levies and false charges of rebellion; Jin Shun was urged to take over his army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Cheng Lu was dismissed and arrested for extortion and false treason; Jin Shun was told to assume his troops.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，滇軍克大理，回酋杜文秀、楊榮、蔡廷棟等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Yunnan troops took Dali; Muslim chiefs Du Wenxiu, Yang Rong, and Cai Tingdong were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Yunnan forces captured Dali and executed Du Wenxiu, Yang Rong, and Cai Tingdong.

sentences.zh: 賞岑毓英黃馬褂、騎都尉世職，開復劉岳昭處分，賞楊玉科騎都尉。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying was given a yellow jacket and a hereditary Cavalry Commandant title; Liu Yuezhao's penalties were lifted; Yang Yuke was made Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying won a yellow jacket and hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank; Liu Yuezhao was restored; Yang Yuke became Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，兩宮皇太后以親政屆期，懿旨勉上「祇承家法，講求用人行政，毋荒典學」。

translations.literal: On day yisi, both Empress Dowagers, as personal rule drew near, issued maternal instructions urging the Emperor to "uphold the house law, attend to appointment and administration, and not neglect classical study."
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, both Empress Dowagers exhorted the Emperor to uphold house law, govern well, and keep studying the classics.

sentences.zh: 勖廷臣及中外臣工「公忠盡職，宏濟艱難」。

translations.literal: They exhorted court ministers and officials throughout the empire to "serve loyally in public duty and relieve the hard times."
translations.idiomatic: They urged all officials to serve loyally and ease the crisis.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上親政，詔「恪遵慈訓，敬天法祖，勤政愛民」。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor took personal rule; an edict declared he would "reverently obey maternal teaching, revere Heaven and the ancestors, and govern diligently for the people."
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor assumed personal rule, pledging to obey Cixi, revere heaven and ancestors, and rule for the people.

sentences.zh: 己酉，諭內務府核實撙節，於歲費六十萬外，不得借支。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Imperial Household Department was told to verify savings and not borrow beyond the annual expense of six hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Internal Affairs was barred from borrowing beyond its verified six-hundred-thousand annual budget.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌朔，軍機大臣、六部九卿會議黃、運兩河辦法。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day gengxu: Grand Councilors, the Six Ministries, and the Nine Chief Courts met on policy for the Yellow River and Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, gengxu, the Grand Council and ministries met on Yellow River and Grand Canal policy.

sentences.zh: 諭李鴻章悉心籌辦奏聞。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was told to plan carefully and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was ordered to plan thoroughly and report.

sentences.zh: 下詔修省，求直言。

translations.literal: An edict of self-examination was issued, seeking frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued a self-examination edict and called for straight talk.

sentences.zh: 諭直省舉賢才，杜侵蠹。

translations.literal: Provinces were told to recommend worthy men and stop corruption.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces were urged to promote talent and end graft.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加上兩宮皇太后徽號，翌日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, honorific titles were added for both Empress Dowagers; the next day an edict of general grace was issued with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, both Empress Dowagers gained new honorifics; the next day a grace edict followed with graded favors.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠軍克大通向陽堡。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang's army captured Xiangyang Fort at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang took Datong's Xiangyang Fort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以謁東陵，命惇親王等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, because of the visit to the Eastern Tombs, Prince Dun and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Prince Dun and others stayed in Beijing for the Eastern Tombs visit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金順軍抵肅州剿回匪，敗之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Jin Shun's army reached Suzhou to suppress Hui rebels and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Jin Shun reached Suzhou, beat the Hui rebels, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，上奉兩宮皇太后謁東陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiwei: the Emperor escorted the two Empresses Dowager to the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guiwei, the Emperor took the two empresses dowager to the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the court returned from the tour.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路經過本年額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for the current year were remitted along the imperial route.
translations.idiomatic: This year's quota taxes on the imperial route were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大通、巴燕戎格及五工撒拉各回眾降。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Hui communities at Datong, Bayan Rongge, and Wugong Salar all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Hui groups at Datong, Bayan Rongge, and Wugong Salar surrendered.

sentences.zh: 西寧匪首馬桂源等伏誅。

translations.literal: Rebel chiefs at Xining including Ma Guiyuan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Xining rebel leaders including Ma Guiyuan were executed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上奉兩宮皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor escorted the two Empresses Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor brought the two empresses dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，回匪白彥虎等竄甘州。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Hui rebels including Bai Yanhu fled into Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Bai Yanhu and other Hui rebels fled to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 命議定各國公使覲見禮節。

translations.literal: An order was issued to deliberate the ceremonial for foreign ministers' audiences.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered debate on protocol for foreign ministers' audiences.

sentences.zh: 榮全乞病，不許。

translations.literal: Rong Quan asked sick leave; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan's sick leave was denied.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以英廉為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yinglian was made assistant minister at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yinglian became Tarbagatai assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 丁未，滇軍克順寧。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Yunnan forces captured Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Yunnan troops took Shunning.

sentences.zh: 是春，免江蘇邳州、陝西鄜州等屬被擾逋賦。

translations.literal: That spring, overdue taxes from disturbance were remitted in Pizhou, Jiangsu, Fuzhou, Shaanxi, and other affected districts.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, Pizhou, Jiangsu, Fuzhou, Shaanxi, and other disturbed districts were forgiven overdue taxes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，設廉州北海關。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao: a customs house was established at Beihai, Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, yimao, a Beihai customs house was set up at Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，日本換約成。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the treaty revision with Japan was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the revised treaty with Japan was concluded.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，回匪竄阿拉善旗及阿畢爾米特，諭定安遣軍會防兵夾擊。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Hui rebels fled into the Alashan banner and Abirmite; Ding An was ordered to send troops to join frontier forces in a pincer attack.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Hui rebels fled into Alashan and Abirmite; Ding An was told to join frontier troops in a pincer.

sentences.zh: 己巳，官軍克肅州塔爾灣賊巢。

translations.literal: On day jisi, government troops captured the rebel nest at Taerwan, Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, government forces took the Taerwan rebel nest at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，滇軍克雲州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin: Yunnan forces captured Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, gengyin, Yunnan forces took Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，允各國公使覲見。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, audiences for foreign ministers were approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, foreign ministers were allowed to audience.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，成祿交刑部治罪。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Cheng Lu was handed to the Ministry of Punishments for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Cheng Lu was sent to the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命成瑞署烏魯木齊提督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Cheng Rui was ordered to act as Urumqi provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Cheng Rui was ordered to act as Urumqi commander.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，上幸瀛台，日使副島種臣、俄使倭良嘎哩、美使鏤斐迪、英使威妥瑪、法使熱福哩、荷使費果蓀覲見於紫光閣，呈遞國書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: the Emperor went to Yingtai; Japanese envoy Soejima Taneomi, Russian envoy Vlangaly, American minister Low, British minister Wade, French minister Rémer, and Dutch minister Fison had audience at Ziguang Pavilion and presented their credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renzi, at Yingtai the Emperor received Soejima, Vlangaly, Low, Wade, Rémer, and Fison at Ziguang Pavilion with their credentials.

sentences.zh: 庚申，嚴趣金順出關。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Jin Shun was strictly urged to leave the pass and advance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Jin Shun was sharply ordered out of the pass.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，甘軍復循化，匪目馬玉連等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Gansu troops recovered Xunhua; rebel leaders including Ma Yulian were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Gansu forces retook Xunhua and executed Ma Yulian and other chiefs.

sentences.zh: 閏六月甲申，李鴻章覆陳黃、運兩河淮、徐故道難復，請仍海運。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day jiashen: Li Hongzhang replied that the old courses of the Yellow and transport rivers through Huai and Xu were hard to restore and asked to continue sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 6, jiashen, Li Hongzhang said the Huai-Xu river routes could not be restored and asked to keep sea transport.

sentences.zh: 其舊河涸地，酌量升課。

translations.literal: Dried-up land of the old riverbeds was to be assessed for tax increase as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Tax on the dried old riverbeds was to be raised as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 議行。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朱鳳標卒。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhu Fengbiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhu Fengbiao died.

sentences.zh: 滇軍克騰越，予岑毓英一等輕車都尉，賞劉岳昭黃馬褂，楊玉科一等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: Yunnan forces captured Tengyue; Cen Yuying was given first-rank Light Chariot Commandant; Liu Yuezhao was awarded the yellow riding jacket; Yang Yuke was given first-rank Light Chariot Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan took Tengyue; Cen Yuying gained first-rank Light Chariot Commandant, Liu Yuezhao a yellow jacket, and Yang Yuke first-rank Light Chariot Commandant.

sentences.zh: 以雲南軍興十有八年，郡縣多為賊蹂躪，詔免十一年以前積欠糧賦，並永遠停徵濟軍釐穀。

translations.literal: Because the Yunnan war had lasted eighteen years and many districts had been ravaged, an edict remitted grain-tax arrears before the eleventh year and permanently stopped the grain levy for troop support.
translations.idiomatic: After eighteen years of war in Yunnan, arrears before year 11 were forgiven and the troop-support grain levy was ended forever.

sentences.zh: 諭劉岳昭慎選牧令，察吏安民。

translations.literal: Liu Yuezhao was instructed to choose prefects and magistrates carefully, inspect officials, and settle the people.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuezhao was told to pick good magistrates, watch officials, and calm the people.

sentences.zh: 甲午，京畿久雨，上祈晴。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, prolonged rain in the capital region led the Emperor to pray for clear weather.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor prayed for sun after long rain around the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔查各省畝捐、釐捐及丁漕違制者，次第豁除。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, an edict ordered investigation of unauthorized per-mou levies, lijin, and grain-transport surcharges in each province, to be progressively abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, an edict told each province to find and abolish illegal mou levies, lijin, and transport surcharges.

sentences.zh: 庚子，甘軍剿白彥虎等於敦煌，失利，副將李天和等死之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Gansu forces fought Bai Yanhu and others at Dunhuang, were defeated, and Vice Commander Li Tianhe and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Gansu troops lost to Bai Yanhu at Dunhuang; Vice Commander Li Tianhe and others fell.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River breached.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River broke its banks.

sentences.zh: 免阿爾泰烏梁海七旗貢貂。

translations.literal: Tribute sable from the seven banners of Altai Uriankhai was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sable tribute from Altai Uriankhai's seven banners was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，桂軍剿西林、西隆匪，平之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: Guangxi forces suppressed rebels in Xilin and Xilong and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, xinhai, Guangxi troops cleared Xilin and Xilong rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑順天災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Shuntian disaster victims were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Shuntian flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山東青城被水新舊額賦。

translations.literal: That month, new and old quota taxes were remitted for Qingcheng, Shandong, after flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Qingcheng, Shandong, was forgiven new and old quota taxes after floods.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑朔，都興阿乞病，慰留之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon day dingchou: Duxing'a asked sick leave; he was urged to stay on.
translations.idiomatic: At the month-8 new moon, dingchou, Duxing'a asked to quit for illness but was kept on.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，直隸運河堤決。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Grand Canal dyke in Zhili breached.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Zhili Grand Canal embankment broke.

sentences.zh: 榮全復以病乞免，不許。

translations.literal: Rong Quan again asked to be excused for illness; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Quan again asked sick leave and was refused.

sentences.zh: 富和有罪褫職。

translations.literal: Fu He was guilty and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Fu He was found guilty and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，白彥虎等陷馬蓮井營堡。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Bai Yanhu and others captured the Magunying camp fort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Bai Yanhu took the Magunying camp.

sentences.zh: 召劉岳昭入覲，以岑毓英兼署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Liu Yuezhao was summoned to audience; Cen Yuying was ordered to act additionally as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuezhao was called to court; Cen Yuying also acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，白彥虎等圍哈密，犯巴里坤，官軍失利。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Bai Yanhu and others besieged Hami and raided Barkol; government troops were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Bai Yanhu besieged Hami and raided Barkol; government forces lost.

sentences.zh: 乙未，諭景廉督軍赴援，調錫綸為烏魯木齊領隊大臣，以明春為哈密幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Jing Lian was ordered to lead troops to reinforce; Xilun was transferred as Urumqi commandery vice director; Mingchun was made assistant commissioner at Hami.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Jing Lian was sent to reinforce; Xilun became Urumqi vice director and Mingchun Hami assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸各屬、永順府屬暨公安水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given in Zhili districts, Yongshun prefecture, and Gong'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month, floods in Zhili, Yongshun, and Gong'an were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，命軍機大臣會刑部審擬成祿罪。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: Grand Council ministers were ordered to join the Ministry of Punishments in deliberating Cheng Lu's sentence.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingyin, the Grand Council joined Punishments to sentence Cheng Lu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，御史沈淮疏請緩修圓明園。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon day bingzi: Censor Shen Huai memorialized to postpone rebuilding the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10 new moon, bingzi, Censor Shen Huai asked to delay Yuanmingyuan repairs.

sentences.zh: 諭令內務府僅治安佑宮為駐蹕殿宇，餘免興修。

translations.literal: The Imperial Household Department was told to repair only the Anyou Palace as residence; other work was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Household Department was told to ready only Anyou Palace and stop other building.

sentences.zh: 己亥，官軍克肅州，匪逆馬文祿伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jihai, government troops captured Suzhou; rebel Ma Wenlu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, government forces took Suzhou and executed Ma Wenlu.

sentences.zh: 上詣兩宮皇太后賀捷。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to congratulate the two Empresses Dowager on the victory.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor congratulated the two empresses dowager on the victory.

sentences.zh: 庚子，論功，命左宗棠以陝甘總督協辦大學士，加一等輕車都尉；

translations.literal: On day gengzi, for merit, Zuo Zongtang as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general was made associate Grand Secretary and given one additional grade of Light Chariot Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zuo Zongtang was made associate Grand Secretary with an added Light Chariot Commandant grade;

sentences.zh: 復金順職，賞還黃馬褂；

translations.literal: Jin Shun's office was restored and his yellow jacket returned;
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun's post and yellow jacket were restored;

sentences.zh: 予徐占彪、穆圖善雲騎尉。

translations.literal: Xu Zhanbiao and Mutushan were granted Captaincy of Cloud Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhanbiao and Mutushan received Cloud Cavalry captaincies.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，越南王疏請會剿河陽、興化、山西、宣光邊地諸匪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei: the king of Vietnam memorialized requesting joint suppression of bandits in the border regions of Heyang, Xinghua, Shanxi, and Xuangang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiwei, Vietnam asked for joint action against bandits in Heyang, Xinghua, Shanxi, and Xuangang.

sentences.zh: 諭劉長佑、馮子材議奏。

translations.literal: Liu Changyou and Feng Zicai were instructed to deliberate and memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Changyou and Feng Zicai were told to report a plan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，法、越構釁，法兵破河內省城，越匪擾北寧。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, France and Vietnam clashed; French troops took Hanoi city; Vietnamese rebels harassed Beining.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, France and Vietnam fought; the French took Hanoi and rebels troubled Beining.

sentences.zh: 越人求援。

translations.literal: The Vietnamese sought aid.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam asked China for help.

sentences.zh: 諭瑞麟飭軍由欽州出關，會桂軍援剿之。

translations.literal: Ruilin was told to drive his army out from Qinzhou to join Guangxi forces in relief and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Ruilin was ordered out from Qinzhou with Guangxi troops to help suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲子，御史吳可讀請將成祿明正典刑。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Censor Wu Kedu asked that Cheng Lu receive the proper statutory punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Censor Wu Kedu demanded Cheng Lu face the full penalty.

sentences.zh: 己巳，岑毓英奏整頓吏治營伍，並請撤勇停捐，自雲南始。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Cen Yuying memorialized on rectifying administration and the army camps, and asked to dismiss braves and stop levies, beginning in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Cen Yuying asked to fix officials and troops and end braves and levies, starting in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉之。

translations.literal: An edict praised this.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised the proposal.

sentences.zh: 庚午，疏濬運河。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Grand Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Grand Canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 壬申，成祿論斬。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Cheng Lu was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Cheng Lu was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 吳可讀坐刺聽朝政降調。

translations.literal: Wu Kedu was demoted for overhearing court discussions.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kedu was reduced in rank for eavesdropping on court business.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，回匪竄擾烏梁海等部，錫綸軍追剿，敗之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: Hui rebels raided Uriankhai and other departments; Xilun's army pursued and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiashen, Hui rebels raided Uriankhai; Xilun pursued and beat them.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以磨勘順天舉人徐景春試卷荒謬，考官尚書全慶、都御史胡家玉等降黜有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, because Shuntian graduate Xu Jingchun's examination paper in reassessment was absurd, examiners including Minister Quanqing and Censor-in-chief Hu Jiayu were degraded to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Xu Jingchun's absurd Shuntian paper cost examiners Quanqing, Hu Jiayu, and others demotions.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命額勒和布赴烏里雅蘇台查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Elehebu was ordered to proceed to Uliassutai to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Elehebu was sent to Uliassutai to investigate.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賞故提督劉松山一等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the late General Liu Songshan was posthumously given first-rank Light Chariot Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the late Liu Songshan received first-rank Light Chariot Commandant.

sentences.zh: 命張曜、金順分軍西進。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao and Jin Shun were ordered to advance west with divided armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao and Jin Shun were told to march west in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以慈禧皇太后四旬慶典，推恩近支王公及中外大臣，賚敘有差。

translations.literal: On day renyin, for the Empress Dowager Cixi's fortieth-birthday celebration, grace was extended to collateral princes and Chinese and foreign officials with rewards of varying rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Cixi's fortieth birthday brought graded rewards to princes and officials at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年甲戌春正月乙巳朔，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Year 13, spring, first month new moon day yisi: banquet feasts were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13, spring, month 1 new moon yisi, court banquets were suspended.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，湘軍剿古州苗匪，平之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Hunan troops suppressed Miao bandits at Guzhou and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Hunan forces cleared Guzhou Miao bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命編修張英麟、檢討王慶祺直弘德殿。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Compiler Zhang Yinglin and Reviser Wang Qingqi were assigned duty at the Hongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Zhang Yinglin and Wang Qingqi were posted to Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以劉坤一、胡家玉互參，降坤一三品頂帶，褫職留任，家玉鐫五級調用。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because Liu Kunyi and Hu Jiayu had impeached each other, Kunyi was reduced three grades in cap rank, stripped of office but retained in post; Jiayu was cut five grades and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, mutual impeachment cost Liu Kunyi three cap grades and nominal dismissal while Hu Jiayu lost five grades and was transferred.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭築東明長堤。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict ordered construction of the long dyke at Dongming.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the court ordered Dongming's long embankment built.

sentences.zh: 己巳，官軍援沙山子擊回匪，勝之，賞福珠哩黃馬褂。

translations.literal: On day jisi, government troops aiding at Shashanzi struck Hui rebels and won; Fuzhuli was awarded the yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, troops at Shashanzi beat Hui rebels and Fuzhuli won a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，回匪擾巴里坤境，明春等會剿之。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao: Hui rebels harassed the Barkol frontier; Mingchun and others jointly suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jimao, Hui rebels raided Barkol; Mingchun and others suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以法取越南地，越匪擾山西，偪滇疆，諭岑毓英部署邊防。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, because France had seized Vietnamese territory and Vietnamese rebels harassed Shanxi, pressing the Yunnan border, Cen Yuying was instructed to deploy frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, French gains and rebels in Vietnam near Yunnan led the court to tell Cen Yuying to fortify the border.

sentences.zh: 禁京師私鑄。

translations.literal: Private coining was forbidden in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing private coining was banned.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上奉兩宮謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor escorted the two Empresses to the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor took the two empresses to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，還宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen: return to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jiachen, the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賑奉天災民。

translations.literal: On day yisi, disaster victims in Fengtian were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Fengtian disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命寶鋆協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Baojun was made associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Baojun became associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 己酉，修海寧石塘。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the stone sea-wall at Haining was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Haining's stone seawall was repaired.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，論肅清貴州功，復陶茂林提督，賞提督何世華等世職。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, for merit in clearing Guizhou, Tao Maolin was restored as provincial commander; Generals He Shihua and others received hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, clearing Guizhou restored Tao Maolin as commander and gave He Shihua and others hereditary ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛未，日本兵艦泊廈門，諭沈葆楨統兵輪往，相機籌辦。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Japanese warships anchored at Amoy; Shen Baozhen was instructed to command the navy and proceed there to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Japanese ships reached Amoy; Shen Baozhen was told to take the fleet and handle it as needed.

sentences.zh: 命李鴻章與秘魯公使會議華工事宜。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was ordered to confer with the Peruvian minister on Chinese laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was told to meet the Peruvian minister on Chinese workers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，詔撥帑十萬撫恤烏里雅蘇台災擾部落。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu: the treasury allotted 100,000 taels to comfort tribes afflicted by disaster and disturbance at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, jiaxu, 100,000 taels were sent to comfort Uliassutai tribes hit by disaster.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上幸瀛台。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor went to Yingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Emperor went to Yingtai.

sentences.zh: 單懋謙因病乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Shan Maoqian asked retirement for illness; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Maoqian retired for illness.

sentences.zh: 覲見俄使布策等於紫光閣。

translations.literal: He received an audience with Russian envoy Bazanov and others at Ziguang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor received Bazanov and other Russian envoys at Ziguang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上幸圓明園還宮。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor visited the Yuanmingyuan and returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor visited Yuanmingyuan and returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，瑪那斯回匪犯奎屯等處，官軍進剿失利，景廉兵援之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Hui rebels from Manas attacked Kuitun and other places; the advancing government army was defeated; Jing Lian's troops went to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Manas Hui rebels hit Kuitun; the advance force lost and Jing Lian marched to help.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，日本兵船抵台灣登岸，與生番尋釁。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Japanese warships reached Taiwan and landed ashore; they provoked clashes with the aborigines.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Japanese ships landed on Taiwan and clashed with aborigines.

sentences.zh: 命沈葆楨辦海防，兼理各國事務大臣，江、廣沿海各口輪船，以時調遣。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen was ordered to manage coastal defense and also to serve as minister for foreign affairs; steamships at Jiangsu and Guangdong coastal ports were to be deployed on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen took coastal defense and foreign affairs; Jiang and Guang steamers were to be deployed on time.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，常順緣事褫職，命額勒和布為烏里雅蘇台將軍，慶春為察哈爾都統，托倫布為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Chang Shun was stripped of office for cause; Elehebu was made Uliasutai general, Qingchun Chakhar commander, and Tuolunbu Kobdo councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Chang Shun was dismissed; Elehebu, Qingchun, and Tuolunbu received frontier posts.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜陸潤庠等三百三十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Lu Runxiang and three hundred thirty-seven others received jinshi degrees with titles varying by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Lu Runxiang and 337 others received jinshi with graded titles.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，景廉再乞病，不許。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Jing Lian again asked sick leave; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Jing Lian again sought sick leave and was refused.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅朔，法、越和議定，諭邊將安輯內遷難民。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon day renyin: the Franco-Vietnamese peace was settled; border generals were ordered to settle refugees who had moved inward.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, on the new moon renyin, Franco-Vietnamese peace was set and border generals were told to settle inward refugees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上幸圓明園還宮。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the emperor returned from the Old Summer Palace to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the emperor returned from Yuanmingyuan to the palace.

sentences.zh: 日本攻台灣番社。

translations.literal: Japan attacked Taiwan aboriginal settlements.
translations.idiomatic: Japan attacked Taiwan aboriginal villages.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以慈禧太后聖節，予在京旗官六十以上者恩賞，停本年秋審、朝審人犯句決。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, for Empress Dowager Cixi's birthday, banner officials in Beijing over sixty were rewarded, and executions at the autumn and court capital reviews were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, for Cixi's birthday, Beijing banner elders were rewarded and capital review executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 己未，彗星見。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔賑奉天災民。

translations.literal: On day yichou, an edict ordered relief for Fengtian disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Fengtian disaster victims were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，允沈葆楨請，建台灣海口炮台，撫番社，撤疲兵。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Shen Baozhen's request was granted: build Taiwan coastal forts, pacify aboriginal settlements, and withdraw worn-out troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Taiwan forts, aborigine pacification, and withdrawal of tired troops were approved for Shen Baozhen.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，日本師船游弋福建各海口。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Japanese warships cruised the ports of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Japanese warships cruised Fujian ports.

sentences.zh: 日使柳原前光與總署王大臣商台灣兵事。

translations.literal: The Japanese minister Yanagihara Sakimitsu discussed Taiwan military affairs with the Zongli Yamen princes.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese minister Yanagihara discussed Taiwan with the Zongli Yamen princes.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，諭飭總兵孫開華接辦廈門防務。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: an edict ordered Brigadier Sun Kaihua to take over Xiamen defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, yihai, Sun Kaihua was ordered to take Xiamen defenses.

sentences.zh: 己卯，召楊岳斌、曾國荃、閻敬銘、趙德轍、丁日昌、鮑超、蔣益澧、郭嵩燾來京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yang Yuebin, Zeng Guoquan, Yan Jingming, Zhao Dezhe, Ding Richang, Bao Chao, Jiang Yili, and Guo Songtao were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yang Yuebin, Zeng Guoquan, Yan Jingming, and six others were called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，烏索寨降眾復叛，滇軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, submitters at Wusuo Stockade rebelled again; Yunnan troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Wusuo submitters rebelled and Yunnan troops put them down.

sentences.zh: 癸未，允李鴻章請，以徐州唐定奎軍渡海赴台。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Li Hongzhang's request was granted: Tang Dingkui's Xuzhou army was sent by sea to Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Tang Dingkui's Xuzhou army was sent by sea to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，諭戶部撙節不急之需，豫籌海防經費。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Revenue Board was ordered to cut non-urgent spending and prepare coastal defense funds in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Revenue Board was told to economize and fund coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 諭沈葆楨部署南北路防守。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen was ordered to deploy north- and south-route defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen was told to arrange north and south route defenses.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命翁同龢仍直弘德殿。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Weng Tonghe was again appointed to Hongde Hall duty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Weng Tonghe again served at Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，李鶴年請閩省陸路選立練軍，議行。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: Li Henian proposed selecting a drilled army on Fujian's land routes; the plan was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, dingwei, Li Henian's Fujian drilled-army plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，瑪納斯回匪犯西湖，官軍擊退之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Manas Hui rebels attacked Xihu; government troops repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Manas Hui struck Xihu and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命左宗棠為大學士，仍留陝甘總督任，景廉為欽差大臣，督辦新疆軍務，金順幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Zuo Zongtang was made Grand Secretary while remaining Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Jing Lian was made imperial commissioner to supervise Xinjiang military affairs, with Jin Shun assisting.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zuo Zongtang became Grand Secretary; Jing Lian took Xinjiang command and Jin Shun assisted.

sentences.zh: 庚申，覲見比使謝恩施等於紫光閣。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Belgian minister Thys and others were received in audience at the Ziguang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Belgian minister Thys and others were received at Ziguang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 甲子，內務府大臣貴寶以任郎中時，於知府李光昭報效木植，欺罔奏陳，嚴議褫職。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Neiwufu minister Guibao, for having deceived the throne in the Li Guangzhao timber memorial while serving as a department director, was severely punished and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Guibao was dismissed for deceit in the Li Guangzhao timber case.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，馬賊陷寧古塔，旋復之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, mounted bandits took Ningguta but it was soon recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, bandits took Ningguta and it was soon retaken.

sentences.zh: 允福建軍餉借用洋款二百萬，由海關稅分年抵還。

translations.literal: Fujian military funds were allowed to borrow two million in foreign loans, to be repaid in yearly installments from customs revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was allowed a two-million foreign loan repaid from customs over time.

sentences.zh: 己巳，停修圓明園工程。

translations.literal: On day jisi, construction at the Old Summer Palace was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yuanmingyuan construction was halted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諭責恭親王召對失儀，奪親王世襲，降郡王，仍為軍機大臣，並革載澂貝勒郡王銜。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Prince Gong was rebuked for impropriety at audience; his princely inheritance was removed and he was demoted to prince of the second rank, though he remained on the Grand Council; Zaichen's princely title was also revoked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Prince Gong lost his inheritance and rank for audience impropriety but stayed on the Grand Council; Zaichen's title was revoked.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎等犯濟木薩，官軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu and others attacked Jimusa; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu attacked Jimusa and was beaten off.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，懿旨復恭親王世襲及載澂爵銜，訓勉之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon day xinwei: an empress dowager edict restored Prince Gong's inheritance and Zaichen's titles, with admonition.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, on the new moon xinwei, Prince Gong's inheritance and Zaichen's titles were restored with admonition.

sentences.zh: 諭修葺三海工程，力求撙節。

translations.literal: An edict ordered repairs to the Three Seas works with strict economy.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Seas repairs were ordered with strict economy.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，河南蝗。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, locusts struck Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, locusts struck Henan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李光昭論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Li Guangzhao was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Li Guangzhao was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，諭各省整頓捕務。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the provinces were ordered to improve constabulary affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, provinces were told to improve policing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命左宗棠督辦西征糧台轉運事宜，以內閣學士袁保恆為幫辦。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Zuo Zongtang was ordered to supervise Western expedition grain transport, with Academician Yuan Baoheng assisting.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Zuo Zongtang took Western expedition grain transport and Yuan Baoheng assisted.

sentences.zh: 詔各省酌裁釐局，禁種罌粟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the provinces to trim likin bureaus as appropriate and ban opium cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to trim likin offices and ban opium growing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，閱御前王大臣、乾清門侍衛射。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the emperor reviewed archery of front princes and Qianqing Gate guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the emperor reviewed princes' and guards' archery.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，上幸晾鷹台，撒圍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon day gengzi: the emperor visited the Liangying Platform and lifted the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, on the new moon gengzi, the emperor visited Liangying Platform and ended the enclosure hunt.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上幸晾鷹台，閱神機營兵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the emperor visited the Liangying Platform and reviewed the Shenji Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the emperor reviewed the Shenji Camp at Liangying Platform.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，閱王大臣、侍衛等射。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the emperor reviewed archery of princes and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the emperor reviewed princes' and guards' archery.

sentences.zh: 丁未，瑞麟卒，以英翰為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Ruilin died; Ying Han was made Liang-Guang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Ruilin died and Ying Han became Liang-Guang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，日本續遣大久保利通來，與總署王大臣論台灣番社兵事。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Japan again sent Okubo Toshimichi to discuss the Taiwan aborigine affair with the Zongli Yamen princes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Okubo Toshimichi came to discuss Taiwan with the Zongli Yamen princes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，寧古塔匪首王文拴伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Ningguta bandit chief Wang Wenshuan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Wang Wenshuan of Ningguta was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王大臣與日使成議，退兵回國，給日本難民恤金及台灣軍費共五十萬。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the princes reached agreement with the Japanese envoy: troops would withdraw, and five hundred thousand taels would be paid for Japanese refugee relief and Taiwan military costs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Japan agreed to withdraw for five hundred thousand in relief and Taiwan costs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賈楨卒。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Jia Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Jia Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，諭李鴻章等於總署條奏海防、練兵、簡器、造船、籌餉、用人、持久諸事，詳議以聞。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Li Hongzhang and others were ordered at the Zongli Yamen to deliberate in detail on coastal defense, drilling, arms, shipbuilding, funds, personnel, and long-term policy, and report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Li Hongzhang and others were told to plan coastal defense, drilling, arms, ships, funds, men, and sustainability.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，以慈禧皇太后四旬萬壽，復劉銘傳提督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei: for Empress Dowager Cixi's fortieth birthday, Liu Mingchuan was restored as provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, xinwei, Liu Mingchuan was restored as commander for Cixi's fortieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上慶賀禮成，賞廢員職銜，免王公、文武官處分，餘進敘有差。

translations.literal: On day jimao, when the celebration rites were completed, dismissed officials' ranks were restored, penalties on princes and civil and military officials were remitted, and the rest were promoted by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, after the celebration, dismissed ranks were restored, officials were pardoned, and others were promoted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，恤廣東颶災。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, relief was ordered for Guangdong typhoon victims.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Guangdong typhoon victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命廣壽、夏同善赴陝西查事。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Guangshou and Xia Tongshan were sent to Shaanxi to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Guangshou and Xia Tongshan were sent to investigate in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上不豫，命李鴻藻代閱章奏。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the emperor was unwell; Li Hongzao was ordered to read memorials in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the emperor fell ill and Li Hongzao read memorials for him.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，命恭親王代繕批答清文摺件。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: Prince Gong was ordered to draft Manchu endorsements on memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiachen, Prince Gong drafted Manchu memorial endorsements.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賑徐、海水災。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, relief was ordered for disasters in Xu and Hai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Xu and Hai disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命內外奏牘呈兩宮披覽。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, memorials inside and outside the capital were ordered shown to both empresses dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, all memorials were to be shown to both empresses dowager.

sentences.zh: 以寶鋆為大學士。

translations.literal: Bao Yun was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Yun became Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 壬子，日本退兵。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Japan withdrew its troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Japan withdrew its troops.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，冬至，祀天圜丘，遣醇親王代。

translations.literal: On day guichou, at the winter solstice heaven was worshipped at the Round Mound Altar; Prince Chun substituted for the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, winter solstice heaven worship was performed by Prince Chun for the emperor.

sentences.zh: 頒部帑百五十萬築石莊戶堤工。

translations.literal: One million five hundred thousand from the ministry treasury was issued for Shizhuanghu dike works.
translations.idiomatic: 1.5 million from the treasury was issued for the Shizhuanghu dike.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上以兩宮調護康吉，崇上徽號，詔刑部及各省罪犯分別減等。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, because both empresses dowager had nursed him back to health, honored titles were raised and the Board of Punishments and all provinces were ordered to reduce sentences by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, honored titles were raised and sentences were reduced province-wide after the empresses' care.

sentences.zh: 庚申，議行河南練軍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, a drilled army for Henan was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Henan's drilled army was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以石莊戶堤難就，允丁寶楨請，於賈庄一帶建壩築堤。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because the Shizhuanghu dike could not be completed, Ding Baozhen's request was granted to build a dam and dike in the Jiazhuang area.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Ding Baozhen was allowed a Jiazhuang dam and dike after Shizhuanghu proved impractical.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，詔蠲免雲南被擾荒地錢糧十年。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: an edict remitted land taxes on disturbed waste land in Yunnan for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, xinwei, Yunnan disturbed waste-land taxes were remitted for ten years.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李宗羲病免，以劉坤一署兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Li Zongxi was relieved for illness; Liu Kunyi was made acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Li Zongxi left office ill and Liu Kunyi acted as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 上疾大漸，崩於養心殿，年十九。

translations.literal: The emperor's illness became grave; he died at the Hall of Mental Cultivation at age nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died at Yangxin Hall at nineteen after a grave illness.

sentences.zh: 慈安皇太后、慈禧皇太后召惇親王奕誴、恭親王奕訢、醇親王奕譞，孚郡王奕譓、惠郡王奕詳，貝勒載治、載澂，公奕謨，御前大臣伯彥訥謨祜、奕劻、景壽，軍機大臣寶鋆、沈桂芬、李鴻藻，內務府大臣英桂、崇綸、魁齡、榮祿、明善、貴寶、文錫，直弘德殿徐桐、翁同龢、王慶祺，南書房黃鈺、潘祖蔭、孫詒經、徐郙、張家驤入奉懿旨，以醇親王之子承繼文宗為嗣皇帝。

translations.literal: Empresses Dowager Ci'an and Cixi summoned Prince Dun Yicong, Prince Gong Yixin, Prince Chun Yixuan, Prince Fu of the commandery Yishu, Prince Hui of the commandery Yixiang, Beile Zaizhi and Zaichen, Duke Yimo, Ministers of the Imperial Presence Boyan Namuketu, Yikuang, and Jingshou, Grand Councilors Bao Yun, Shen Guifen, and Li Hongzao, Neiwufu ministers Yinggui, Chonglun, Kuiling, Ronglu, Mingshan, Guibao, and Wenshi, Hongde Hall tutors Xu Tong and Weng Tonghe and Wang Qingqi, and Southern Study members Huang Yu, Pan Zuyin, Sun Yijing, Xu Fu, and Zhang Jiaxiang to receive an empress dowager edict adopting Prince Chun's son as heir to the Wenzong Emperor and successor emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Ci'an and Cixi summoned the princes, councilors, and tutors and named Prince Chun's son Wenzong's heir and the new emperor.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年二月戊子，皇后阿魯特氏崩。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Guangxu, day wuzi, Empress Alute of the Arute clan died.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu 1, month 2, wuzi, Empress Alute died.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，上尊諡曰繼天開運受中居正保大定功聖智誠孝信敏恭寬毅皇帝，廟號穆宗。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: the posthumous title Jitian Kaiyun Shouzhong Juzheng Baoda Dinggong Shengzhi Chengxiao Xinmin Gongkuan Yi Emperor was conferred and the temple name Muzong was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jihai, the full posthumous title was conferred and the temple name Muzong was fixed.

sentences.zh: 五年三月庚午，葬惠陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu in the fifth year: burial at Huiling.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, month 3, gengwu, he was buried at Huiling.

sentences.zh: 論曰：穆宗沖齡即阼，母后垂簾。

translations.literal: Commentary: Muzong succeeded to the throne in tender years and the empress dowager ruled from behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Muzong reigned young under a regent empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 國運中興，十年之間，盜賊劃平，中外乂安。

translations.literal: The dynasty revived; within ten years bandits were pacified and court and frontier were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The realm revived; in ten years rebels were crushed and all was calm.

sentences.zh: 非夫宮府一體，將相協和，何以臻茲？

translations.literal: Without unity of palace and government and harmony of generals and ministers, how could this have been reached?
translations.idiomatic: Without court unity and harmony of generals, how reach this?

sentences.zh: 泊帝親裁大政，不自暇逸。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally took charge of government, he did not spare himself.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ruled in person, he allowed himself no leisure.

sentences.zh: 遇變修省，至勤也。

translations.literal: On calamity he practiced self-examination — utmost diligence.
translations.idiomatic: On disaster he examined himself — utmost diligence.

sentences.zh: 聞災蠲恤，至仁也。

translations.literal: On hearing of disaster he remitted taxes and gave relief — utmost benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of disaster he remitted and relieved — utmost benevolence.

sentences.zh: 不言符瑞，至明也。

translations.literal: He did not speak of auspicious omens — utmost clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He ignored auspicious omens — utmost clarity.

sentences.zh: 藉使蘄至中壽，日新而光大之，庸詎不與前古媲隆。

translations.literal: Had he reached middle age, renewing himself day by day and growing in glory, how could he not have rivaled the grandeur of antiquity?
translations.idiomatic: Had he lived to middle age, his daily renewal would have matched the ancients in glory.

sentences.zh: 顧乃奄棄臣民，未竟所施，惜哉！

translations.literal: Yet he suddenly abandoned his people, his work unfinished — pity indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Yet he died young, his work unfinished — pity indeed!
